title: French tourist dies in Death Valley after car gets stuck in mud
english: A 68-year-old French tourist died in California's Death Valley after his vehicle became trapped in mud during extreme heat. He and his companion attempted to walk for help, but the victim succumbed to temperatures exceeding 46 degrees Celsius. Officials noted that the harsh environment remains dangerous even for experienced travelers, especially during current record-breaking heatwaves.
amharic: የ68 ዓመት የፈረንሳይ ቱሪስት በካሊፎርኒያ ደዝ ቫሊ መኪናቸው በጭቃ በመጣበቁ ምክንያት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። እሳቸው እና አብረዋቸው የነበሩት ሰው ለእርዳታ በእግር ሲጓዙ የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከ46 ዲግሪ ሴልሺየስ በላይ በሆነው ከፍተኛ ሙቀት የተነሳ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ እንደገለጹት በአሁኑ ወቅት ያለው ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን ለተጓዦች እጅግ አደገኛ እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Turistiin lammii Faransaay umriin isaanii 68 ta'e tokko, konkolaataan isaanii biyyee keessatti erga makamee booda gammoojjii Deeth Vaalii keessatti lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Isaanifi hiriyaan isaanii gargaarsa argachuuf miilaan yoo deemaniyyuu, ho'i cimaan digrii 46 ol ta'e isaan miidhee jira. Bulchiinsi bakka sanas, ho'i cimaan kun yeroo ammaa bakkeewwan hedduutti mudachaa jiru namoota maraaf balaa guddaa akka qabu akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Muslims celebrate Prophet Muhammad’s birthday
english: Muslim communities in nations including Iraq, Libya, and Morocco recently observed Mawlid al-Nabi to honor the birth of Prophet Muhammad. The occasion was marked by various religious activities, including organized processions and communal prayers. These gatherings serve as a traditional way for followers to commemorate the life and teachings of the Prophet.
amharic: እንደ ኢራቅ፣ ሊቢያ እና ሞሮኮ ባሉ ሀገራት የሚገኙ ሙስሊሞች የነቢዩ መሐመድን ልደት ለማክበር መውሊድ አል-ነቢን አክብረዋል። በዓሉ በተለያዩ ሃይማኖታዊ ስነ-ስርዓቶች፣ በህዝባዊ ሰልፎች እና በጋራ ጸሎቶች ታጅቦ ተከብሯል። እነዚህ ዝግጅቶች አማኞች የነቢዩን ህይወት እና አስተምህሮ ለማስታወስ የሚጠቀሙባቸው ባህላዊ መንገዶች ናቸው።
oromo: Muslimoonni biyyoota akka Iraaq, Liibiyaa fi Morookoo keessa jiraatan dhaloota Ergamaa Muhammad, Mawliidaan kabajatan. Kabajni kun sagantaalee amantii garaagaraa, hiriiraa fi kadhannaa waloo kan of keessatti qabate ture. Walga’iiwwan kun hordoftoonni jireenyaa fi barsiisa Ergamaa sanaa yaadachuuf kan itti fayyadaman ta’uun beekameera.

title: Man killed in world’s largest annual bullfighting event in Mexico
english: A 29-year-old man lost his life and nine others were hurt during the annual Huamantlada bullfighting festival in Mexico. The event involved releasing 21 bulls onto the streets of Tlaxcala for the public to face. This celebration is recognized as the world's largest open-road bullfighting gathering.
amharic: በሜክሲኮ በሚካሄደው ዓመታዊ የሁአማንትላዳ የበሬ ማታገያ በዓል ላይ የ29 ዓመት ወጣት ህይወቱ ሲያልፍ ሌሎች ዘጠኝ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በቲላክሳላ ከተማ ጎዳናዎች ላይ 21 በሬዎች ተለቀው በነበረበት ወቅት ነው ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው። ይህ በዓል በዓለም ትልቁ የጎዳና ላይ የበሬ ማታገያ ኩነት ተደርጎ ይወሰዳል።
oromo: Meksiikootti ayyaana loon waliin falmiisii waggaa waggaan geggeeffamu kan Huamantlada jedhamu irratti, dargaggeessi umuriin isaa 29 du'eera; namoonni sagal ammoo miidhaniiru. Ayyaanichi magaalaa Tlaaksalaa keessatti loon 21 daandiiwwan irratti gadi dhiisuun kan geggeeffame dha. Ayyaanichi addunyaa irratti walgahii loon walitti fiduun daandii irratti geggeeffamu keessaa isa guddaa dha.

title: Commodity vessel transits through Hormuz Strait drop to three-month low
english: Shipping data indicates that only one commodity vessel passed through the Strait of Hormuz on Monday, marking the lowest activity level in three months. While this figure represents a significant drop since early May, it remains preliminary because some ships may be navigating the area with their tracking devices turned off. As a result, the total count may increase once more comprehensive data becomes available.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የመርከብ መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት ሰኞ ዕለት አንድ የሸቀጥ መርከብ ብቻ በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ማለፉን ሲሆን ይህም ባለፉት ሶስት ወራት ውስጥ እጅግ ዝቅተኛው ቁጥር ነው። ይህ አሃዝ ከግንቦት ወር ወዲህ የታየ ዝቅተኛ እንቅስቃሴ ቢሆንም፣ አንዳንድ መርከቦች መከታተያዎቻቸውን በማጥፋታቸው ምክንያት ቁጥሩ ሊለወጥ እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል። ስለዚህ ተጨማሪ መረጃዎች ሲገኙ ትክክለኛው የዕለቱ የትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ ግልጽ ሊሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Odeeffannoon markabootaa akka agarsiisutti, Wiixata darbe markabni meeshaalee fe'u tokko qofatu boolla Hormuz keessa darbe; kunis sadarkaa gadi aanaa ji'a sadii darbe keessatti mul'ateedha. Lakkoofsi kun ji'a Caamsaa as sadarkaa baay'ee gadi aanaa ta'us, markaboonni tokko tokko meeshaa ittiin of hordofan waan cufataniif lakkoofsi kun jijjiiramuu danda'a. Kanaafuu, odeeffannoon guutuun erga argamee booda lakkoofsi dhugaa ifa ta'uu danda'a.

title: US senator criticises economic 'D-Day' against Iran, says 'Trump is losing'
english: US Senator Chris Murphy has condemned the Trump administration's new economic sanctions against Iran, labeling them an ineffective strategy to mask a failing military campaign. Murphy argued that the US has largely lost the conflict, citing Iran’s control over key shipping routes and the exhaustion of American military resources. He maintains that these new measures are merely a desperate attempt to create an illusion of progress while the American public bears the financial burden of the failed policy.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ሴናተር ክሪስ መርፊ በኢራን ላይ የተጣለውን አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ በመተቸት፣ ይህ እርምጃ በወታደራዊ ዘመቻው የተሸነፈውን የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ውድቀት ለመሸፈን የሚደረግ ሙከራ ነው ብለዋል። ሴናተሩ ኢራን ወሳኝ የሆኑ የባህር መስመሮችን መቆጣጠሯን እና የአሜሪካ የጦር መሣሪያ አቅርቦት መሟጠጡን በመጥቀስ፣ ጦርነቱ በተግባር ኢራንን ተጠቃሚ እንዳደረገ ተናግረዋል። ይህ የኢኮኖሚ ግፊትም የአሜሪካን ሕዝብ ዋጋ እያስከፈለ ያለ ከንቱ ድርጊት መሆኑንም አክለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Senator Ameerikaa Chris Murphy adabbii diinagdee haaraa Iran irratti bu'e akka mala dadhabinaa fi injifannoo dhabuu mootummaan Trump akka dhoksuuf qofa fayyadamuun qeeqe. Murphy, Iran daandiiwwan galaanaatti fayyadamuu fi meeshaaleen waraana Ameerikaas hir'achuu isaanii eeruun, waraanichi guutummaatti Iranif milkaa'ina fiduu isaa ibseera. Adabbiin kunis uummata Ameerikaa gatii guddaa kaffalchiisaa akka jiru fi imaammata bu'a qabeessa hin taane ta'uu isaa himeera.

title: Pakistani army chief discussed 'ending deadlock' in US-Iran talks during visit to Tehran
english: Pakistan's army chief, Asim Munir, visited Tehran to hold high-level meetings with senior Iranian officials regarding regional stability. The discussions focused on finding ways to break the ongoing stalemate in diplomatic negotiations between the United States and Iran. This visit highlights Pakistan's active role in trying to reduce regional tensions and promote long-term peace.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የጦር ኃይሎች አዛዥ አሲም ሙኒር በኢራን ጉብኝት በማድረግ ከከፍተኛ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ጋር በክልሉ መረጋጋት ዙሪያ ተወያይተዋል። የውይይቱ ዋና ትኩረት በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል የቆመውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እንደገና ለማስቀጠል በሚቻልበት መንገድ ላይ ያተኮረ ነበር። ይህ ጉብኝት ፓኪስታን በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት ለማርገብ እና ዘላቂ ሰላምን ለማምጣት እየጣረች መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Paakistaan Asim Muneer, nageenya naannichaa irratti mari’achuuf gara Tehraan imaluun aangeyyota olaanoo Iraan waliin wal arganiiru. Mariin kun mootummoota Amerikaa fi Iraan gidduutti haasawaa dippiloomaasii dhaabbatee ture furuufi waliigaltee irra ga’uuf xiyyeeffate. Imalli kun Paakistaan waldhabiinsa naannichaa hir’isuufi nageenya waaraa fiduuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtu kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Brutal gang attack on strategic Haiti hillside leaves at least 30 dead
english: At least 30 individuals were killed during a violent gang assault in the strategic hillside community of Kenscoff, Haiti. This location is significant because it overlooks important transport routes leading into the capital city, Port-au-Prince. Armed groups have been repeatedly targeting the area to expand their control over the capital region.
amharic: በሄይቲ ኬንስኮፍ በተባለች ስልታዊ በሆነች አካባቢ በታጠቁ ቡድኖች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 30 ሰዎች መገደላቸው ተገልጿል። ይህ ስፍራ ወደ ዋና ከተማዋ ፖርቶፕሪንስ የሚያመሩ ዋና ዋና መንገዶችን የሚቆጣጠር በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት አለው። የታጠቁ ቡድኖች በዋና ከተማዋ ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ለማጠናከር ሲሉ አካባቢውን በተደጋጋሚ እያጠቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Haiti keessatti magaalaa Kenskoof jedhamtu kan bakka tarsiimawaa ta'e irra jirtutti garee hidhata qabuun haleellaa raawwatameen namoonni 30 ol du'aniiru. Magaalaan kun karaalee gurguddoo gara magaalaa guddoo Poorto-Priinsitti geessan waan to'attuuf bakka barbaachisaa dha. Gareewwan hidhattootaa kunneen to'annoo isaanii magaalaa guddootti babal'isuuf jecha yeroo dheeraaf naannicha haleelaa jiru.

title: US plans to revoke business, tourism visas of 200,000 asylum seekers
english: The U.S. government intends to cancel the business and tourism visas of approximately 200,000 individuals who have applied for asylum after entering the country. This move, which would be the largest mass visa revocation in American history, targets those officials believe are using temporary visitor visas to bypass immigration rules. While this action will change the immigration status of these individuals as their asylum claims are processed, it will not lead to immediate deportation.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ወደ ሀገሪቱ በቱሪስት እና በንግድ ቪዛ ገብተው ጥገኝነት የጠየቁ ወደ 200,000 የሚጠጉ ግለሰቦችን ቪዛ ለመሰረዝ አቅዷል። ይህ በአሜሪካ ታሪክ ትልቁ የቪዛ ስረዛ እርምጃ ሊሆን እንደሚችል የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ አላማውም ጊዜያዊ ቪዛን ለቋሚ መኖሪያነት እንደ መጠቀሚያ የሚጠቀሙ ሰዎችን ለመቆጣጠር ነው። ምንም እንኳን ይህ እርምጃ የተጎጂዎችን የኢሚግሬሽን ሁኔታ የሚቀይር ቢሆንም፣ ወዲያውኑ ከሀገር ማስወጣትን ግን አያካትትም።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa namoota biyyattii keessa jiran kanneen viizaa tuurizimii fi daldalaan seenanii booda koolu-galtummaa gaafatan 200,000 ta'an irraa viizaa isaanii haquuf karoorfateera. Tarkaanfichi seenaa Ameerikaa keessatti kan hanga kanaa yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaa namoota viizaa yeroo gabaabaa fayyadamanii biyyattii keessa jiraachuuf yaalan to'achuu dha. Haala kanaan namoonni kunneen haala isaanii keessa jiran jijjiiramus, tarkaanfichi battalatti biyyaa baasuuf kan murteesse miti.

title: DRC’s constitutional battle: The fight over the 2028 vote
english: President Felix Tshisekedi’s push for institutional reform in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has sparked intense debate regarding potential changes to presidential term limits ahead of the 2028 election. While the government claims these reforms are necessary for stability, critics fear they could be used to bypass constitutional restrictions on a third term. This political tension is intensifying as the country continues to struggle with the M23 rebellion in its eastern provinces.

Mootummaan jijjiiramichi tasgabbii biyyaaf barbaachisaa dha jedhee kan falmu yoo ta'u, mormitoonni garuu adeemsichi pireezidaantichi yeroota lama ol aangoo irra akka turan gargaaruu danda'a jedhanii sodaatu. title: Search continues in Tunisia as migrant boat sinking sparks protests
english: A migrant boat carrying 15 people sank off the coast of Tunisia, resulting in at least 12 confirmed deaths and leaving two individuals missing. The tragedy triggered violent protests in the city of Ben Guerdane, where residents burned tires and blocked roads to demand better economic opportunities. Local officials and citizens argue that the lack of jobs and systemic neglect are forcing young people to risk their lives on dangerous sea journeys to Europe.

oromo: Tuniziyaatti dooniin godaantota 15 fe'ee deemaa ture garba keessatti gadi lixuun, namoonni 12 du'uu fi lama immoo akka dhabaman mirkanaa'eera. Balaan kun magaala Ben Guerdane keessatti mormii cimaa kan kaase yoo ta'u, jiraattonni haala jireenyaa fi carraa hojii fooyyee gaafachuudhaan daandiiwwan cufuun mormiisaanii ibsataniiru. Namoonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, carraa hojii dhabuu fi tuffatamuun ijoollee fi dargaggoota biyyattii jireenya fooyyee barbaacha gara Awurooppaa deemuuf gara qarqara du'aatti isaan geessaa jira.

title: UN calls for protection of civilians in Gaza amid Israeli attacks
english: The United Nations has urged for the immediate protection of civilians and aid facilities in Gaza following an Israeli airstrike that damaged three humanitarian warehouses. UN officials emphasized that civilian infrastructure must remain off-limits to military attacks. Furthermore, they called for increased humanitarian aid access to address the growing risk of child malnutrition caused by insufficient supply deliveries.

oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii haleellaa qilleensaatiin godaambaan isaanii sadii erga miidhamee booda, Gaza keessatti namoota nagaa fi dhaabbilee gargaarsaa eeguun akka barbaachisu ibseera. Qondaalonni dhaabbatichaa bu'uuraalee misoomaa namoota nagaaf tajaajilan irratti haleellaa raawwachuun gonkumaa akka hin taane hubachiisaniiru. Dabalataanis, hir'ina gargaarsa nyaataa irraa kan ka'e daa'imman irratti rakkoo miidhamaa jiru hambisuuf, gargaarsi hatattamaan akka dabalu gaafataniiru.

title: Ahmad al-Sharaa hails Syria's removal from US 'terrorism list'
english: Syrian President Ahmad al-Sharaa recently celebrated the United States' decision to remove his country from its list of state sponsors of terrorism. He praised this development as a significant step that will allow Syria to focus on national reconstruction and economic growth. Additionally, he expressed his gratitude toward Donald Trump, describing the policy change as a historic achievement for the Syrian people.

Kana malees, murtoo seena qabeessa kanaaf Pireezidaant Doonaald Traamp galateeffataniiru.

title: Trump removes Syria from 'terrorism list'
english: The Trump administration has officially removed Syria from the U.S. list of state sponsors of terrorism, a significant change that permits military aid and ends export restrictions. Additionally, the U.S. government revoked the terrorist designation for the militant group Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated these shifts are intended to help the Syrian people, despite recent military tensions involving Israel.

oromo: Mootummaan Trump sirnaan Siriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota deggeran keessaa haqeera. Tarkaanfiin kun daldala irratti daangaa ture kaasuun gara fuulduraatti gargaarsa waraanaa biyyattii kennuuf karaa bana. Kana malees, mootummaan Ameerikaa garee Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham jedhamu maqaa shororkeessitoota irraa haqee jira.

title: Israeli settler attacks rise by 63 percent in first seven months of 2026, says Commission
english: A report by the Colonization and Wall Resistance Commission shows that attacks by Israeli settlers in the West Bank surged by 63 percent during the first seven months of 2026. Data indicates that these incidents increased significantly compared to the same timeframe in the previous year. Officials argue that this trend is driven by official government policies and the ongoing expansion of illegal settlements.

Hojjettoonni komishinichaa akka jedhanitti, daballiin kun siyaasa mootummaa fi babal'ina qe'ee seeraan alaa wajjin wal qabatee kan dhufe ta'uu isaa ibsaniiru.

title: UN offers to facilitate fertiliser transit through Strait of Hormuz
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has proposed acting as a neutral mediator to ensure the safe movement of fertilizer shipments through the Strait of Hormuz. This initiative aims to decrease regional tensions and stabilize supply chains affected by current conflicts. The plan requires the consent of all involved parties and would be managed with the assistance of Oman to verify cargo vessels.

title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
english: The United States has officially removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism after nearly five decades, citing the government's efforts to move away from terrorist activities. This decision allows for private sector investment and aims to integrate the nation into the global economy while moving it away from the influence of Russia and China. Led by President Ahmed al-Sharaa, whose formerly militant group has also been removed from terror lists, Syria plans to use this opportunity to stabilize its economy despite ongoing regional security concerns.

title: Moment tornado tears through southern France
english: A powerful tornado recently struck villages in southern France, causing significant damage to residential buildings. More than 40 individuals sustained injuries during the severe storm, which featured winds exceeding 100km/h. The disaster also left thousands of homes without power and resulted in several road closures across the affected areas.
amharic: ኃይለኛ አውሎ ንፋስ በደቡባዊ ፈረንሳይ በሚገኙ መንደሮች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። በሰዓት ከ100 ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ ፍጥነት ባለው በዚህ አውሎ ንፋስ ከ40 በላይ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት የደረሰ ሲሆን በርካታ ቤቶችም ወድመዋል። በአካባቢው የኤሌክትሪክ አገልግሎት መቋረጡ እና መንገዶችም በመዘጋታቸው የነዋሪዎች ህይወት ተጎድቷል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin cimaan tokko kibba Faransaayitti argaman gandoota miidhuun manneen jireenyaa mancaaseera. Obomboleettiin saffisa sa'aatii tokkotti kiilomeetira 100 ol qabu kun namoota 40 ol irratti miidhaa qaamaa geessiseera. Balaa kanaan walqabatee manneen baay'een ibsaa dhabanii jiru akkasumas daandiiwwan gurguddoon cufamuun isaanii gabaafameera.

title: Iran war live: US slaps new sanctions on Iran, warns Tehran trade partners
english: The United States has introduced a fresh round of sanctions against Iran to cut off the regime's financial resources. These measures target key industries such as shipping, technology, aviation, and oil, while also sanctioning dozens of individuals and entities. President Trump is actively calling on global allies to back these economic restrictions.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራንን የገንዘብ ምንጭ ለማድረቅ አዳዲስ ማዕቀቦችን ጥሏል። እነዚህ ማዕቀቦች በተለይ የነዳጅ ንግድ፣ መርከብ፣ አቪዬሽን፣ ቴክኖሎጂ እና ዲጂታል ንብረቶች ላይ ያነጣጠሩ ሲሆን፣ ከ60 በላይ ግለሰቦችና ድርጅቶችንም ያካትታሉ። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ሌሎች የአሜሪካ አጋር አገራት ይህንን የኢኮኖሚ ጫና እንዲቀላቀሉ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa maddaa galii biyyattii guduunfuuf jecha Iran irratti qooda haaraa ta'e kan itti murteesse yoo ta'u, kunis dameewwan akka boba'aa, doonii, xiyyaaraa fi teeknooloojii irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha. Maqaan namoota fi dhaabbilee 60 ol ta'anii kanneen mootummaa Iran gargaaran jedhamanii shakkamanis tarree keessatti hammatamaniiru. Pirezidaanti Traamp biyyoonni michoota ta'an hundi tarkaanfii dinagdee kana akka deggeran gaafataniiru.

title: How US sanctions on Iran ripple through global markets and consumers
english: The US government has imposed significant new sanctions on Iran, targeting its aviation, shipping, technology, and energy sectors to further limit the country's revenue. These measures include a naval blockade and penalties for international trading partners who continue to do business with Tehran. Analysts suggest these actions aim to isolate Iran's economy and discourage global entities from engaging in trade, which could lead to wider disruptions in global markets and energy prices.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የአየር ትራንስፖርት፣ የባህር ጉዞ፣ ቴክኖሎጂ እና የነዳጅ ዘርፎችን ያነጣጠሩ አዳዲስ ማዕቀቦችን በኢራን ላይ ጥሏል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች የኢራንን ገቢ ለመቀነስ የታቀዱ ሲሆን፣ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት በሚቀጥሉ አለም አቀፍ አጋሮች ላይም ቅጣት እንደሚጣል ተገልጿል። የባህር ላይ እገዳንም የሚያካትተው ይህ ውሳኔ በኢራን ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና በመፍጠር በአለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ እና የንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ተጽዕኖ ሊያሳድር እንደሚችል ባለሙያዎች ይናገራሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa dameewwan geejjiba xiyyaaraa, doonii, tekinooloojii fi anniisaa irratti xiyyeeffatuun Iran irratti tarkaaffii diinagdee haaraa fudhateera. Tarkaaffiin kun galii Iran hir'isuuf kan kaayyeffate yoo ta'u, biyyoota Iran waliin daldala itti fufan irrattis adabbii cimaa kan hordofsiisuudha. Qarqara galaanaa cufuus dabalatee tarkaanfiin kun diinagdee Iran qoqqobuun gabaa fi gatii anniisaa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu akka danda'u xiinxaltoonni ibsaniiru.

title: US Supreme Court sides with Trump administration on mail voting
english: The U.S. Supreme Court has issued a ruling that allows the Trump administration to move forward with executive orders aimed at restricting mail-in voting. Although this decision supports the administration's plan, legal experts suggest that ongoing challenges may still delay or limit its implementation before the upcoming midterm elections. Opponents argue that these changes threaten to disrupt election processes and exceed the President's constitutional authority.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር በፖስታ የሚደረግ ድምፅ አሰጣጥን ለመገደብ ያወጣውን ትዕዛዝ እንዲቀጥል ፈቅዷል። ምንም እንኳን ውሳኔው ለአስተዳደሩ ድጋፍ ቢሰጥም፣ በህግ ባለሙያዎች እንደሚታመነው በቀጣዩ ምርጫ ላይ በሙሉ አቅም ተግባራዊ እንደሚሆን እርግጠኛ አይደለም። የተቃዋሚ ወገኖች ይህ ውሳኔ በምርጫ ሂደት ላይ ሁከት ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል እና ከፕሬዚዳንቱ የሕገ መንግሥት ስልጣን ውጪ መሆኑን በመግለጽ ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Ameerikaa kan ta'e, bulchiinsi Tramp sagalee posataan kennamu akka daangessuuf ajaja baase hojiirra oolchuuf karaa baneera. Murtiin kun bulchiinsicha kan deggeru ta'us, qorattoonni seeraa akka jedhanitti, filannoo dhufu dura hojiirra oolchuun isaa shakkii keessa jira. Mirmirtoonni murtee kanaa, jijjiiramoonni kun adeemsa filannoo irratti rakkoo kan uuman fi aangoo perezidaantichaa kan darbe ta'uu isaanii himuun mormaa jiru.

title: US removes Syria from ‘state sponsor of terrorism’ list
english: The United States has officially removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism, following a decision originally announced in July. This move also includes declassifying Hayat Tahrir al-Sham, once led by current President Ahmed al-Sharaa, as a terrorist organization. These changes aim to support economic recovery and international investment in Syria as the country continues its transition under the new leadership.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ሶሪያን ከአሸባሪዎች ደጋፊ ሀገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ በይፋ ሰርዟል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከዚህ ቀደም በአሁኑ የሶሪያ ፕሬዝዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ ይመራ የነበረውን ‘ሀያት ተህሪር አል-ሻም’ ቡድንን ከአሸባሪዎች ዝርዝር ውስጥ እንዲወጣ ያደርጋል። ይህ እርምጃ ሀገሪቱ በለውጥ ሂደት ላይ እያለች ለኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት እና ለውጭ ኢንቨስትመንት መነቃቃት መንገድ ይከፍታል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyya Suriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota deeggaran jedhamu irraa haquusaa beeksiseera. Murtiin kun garee ‘Hayat Tahrir al-Sham’ jedhamu kan yeroo durii pirezidaantii ammaatti, Ahmed al-Sharaa, hogganamaa ture illee tarree shororkeessitoota keessaa akka bahu taasiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti tasgabbii dinagdee uumuufi invastimantii alaa harkisuuf gargaara jedhamee amanama.

title: Jeffries-Kushner meeting sparks speculation amid contentious US midterms
english: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries recently held a private meeting with Jared Kushner to explore potential bipartisan cooperation ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. The discussion reportedly covered critical topics like immigration, housing, and inflation, though specific details remain undisclosed. This move suggests the Trump administration may be preparing for a shift in power should Democrats successfully regain control of the House.
amharic: የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አናሳ መሪ ሀኪም ጄፍሪስ ከመጪው የመሃል ዘመን ምርጫ በፊት ሊኖር ስለሚችል የሁለትዮሽ ትብብር ለመወያየት ከጃሬድ ኩሽነር ጋር በግል ተገናኝተዋል። ውይይቱ እንደ ስደት፣ መኖሪያ ቤት እና የኑሮ ውድነት ያሉ አበይት ጉዳዮችን ያካተተ ቢሆንም ዝርዝር መረጃው ይፋ አልወጣም። ይህ ስብሰባ ዴሞክራቶች የምክር ቤቱን የበላይነት መልሰው የሚያገኙ ከሆነ አስተዳደሩ ሊኖር ስለሚችለው የሥልጣን ለውጥ ቅድመ ዝግጅት እያደረገ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni paartii mormituu Mana Maree Bakka Bu'oota Ummataa Hakeem Jeffries, filannoo gidduu waggaa dhufuun dura walitti dhufeenya lamaan qabatee hojjechuuf, Jared Kushner waliin marii dhimma dhuunfaa ta'e taasisaniiru. Marichi dhimmoota ijoo kanneen akka godaantotaa, manaa fi gatii jireenyaa irratti xiyyeeffateera, garuu bal'inni isaa ifa hin taane. Walgahichi kun, yoo paartiin Dimookraatawaa to'annoo Mana Maree deebisanii argatan mootummaan Trump jijjiirama dhufuuf qophii ta'uu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: US public support for Iran war falls as Trump approval at record low: Poll
english: A recent poll indicates that public backing for the ongoing U.S. conflict with Iran has hit a new low, influenced by rising fuel costs and concerns about a prolonged war. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump's approval rating has dropped to his record minimum as fewer Republicans continue to support the military campaign. Despite the administration's plan to escalate economic sanctions against Tehran, a vast majority of Americans now anticipate that the fighting will continue for an extended period.
amharic: አዲስ የተደረገ የሕዝብ አስተያየት ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ላለው ጦርነት የአሜሪካውያን ድጋፍ በነዳጅ ዋጋ ጭማሪ እና በጦርነቱ መዘግየት ምክንያት ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን ያሳያል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ተወዳጅነት ወደ ታሪካዊ ዝቅተኛ ደረጃ የወረደ ሲሆን፣ የሪፐብሊካን ደጋፊዎችም ለወታደራዊ ዘመቻው ያላቸው ድጋፍ እየቀነሰ መጥቷል። መንግሥት በኢራን ላይ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን ለማጠናከር ቢዘጋጅም፣ አብዛኛዎቹ አሜሪካውያን ግጭቱ ለረጅም ጊዜ እንደሚቀጥል ስጋት አላቸው።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan tokko akka ibsutti, deeggarsi ummata Ameerikaa waraana Iraan irratti geggeeffamuuf qaban gatii boba’aa dabee fi waraanni dheerachuu isaa sodachuu irraan kan ka’e sadarkaa gadi aanaatti gadi bu’eera. Yeroo wal fakkaatu kanatti, fudhatamni Preezidaant Doonald Tiraamp sadarkaa seenaa keessatti gadi aanaa ta’etti kan kufe yoo ta’u, deggartoonni Paartii Ripaabilikaanii waraana kanaaf qabanis hir’ateera. Mootummaan biyyattii tarkaanfii dinagdee Iraan irratti fudhatamu cimsuuf karoorfate iyyuu, lammiileen Ameerikaa hedduun walitti bu’iinsi kun yeroo dheeraaf kan itti fufu ta’uu isaa sodaatu.

title: Iconic Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour passes away at age 79
english: Renowned Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour has passed away at the age of 79. He was widely celebrated for creating powerful imagery that symbolized Palestinian identity, cultural heritage, and the enduring struggle against displacement. His artistic legacy remains a significant pillar in documenting the history and resilience of his people.
amharic: ታዋቂው ፍልስጤማዊ ሰዓሊ ስሊማን ማንሱር በ79 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። አርቲስቱ የፍልስጤምን ማንነት፣ ባህል እና ለነፃነት የሚያደርጉትን ተጋድሎ በሚያሳዩ ስራዎቹ ይታወቃሉ። የእሳቸው የጥበብ ስራዎች የህዝባቸውን ታሪክ እና ጥንካሬ በመመዝገብ ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ነበራቸው።
oromo: Artistii beekamaa Falastiin Sliman Mansuur umurii waggaa 79tti du'aan boqoteera. Inni hojiiwwan aartii uummata Falastiin, aadaa fi qabsoo bilisummaa isaanii ibsan uumuun beekama ture. Hojiiwwan isaa seenaa fi jabinna uummata isaa calaqqisiisuun kan yaadatamuu dha.

title: Displaced Palestinians in Gaza face intensifying Israeli strikes
english: Israeli military forces have increased their attacks on Gaza, including a recent strike on a tent area for displaced families in Deir al-Balah. This violence has resulted in at least one death at the site and contributes to a rising toll of over 1,300 Palestinian deaths since the end of the October ceasefire. Displaced civilians continue to struggle with unsafe conditions as military operations intensify across the region.

Waraanni kun erga sochiin dhaabbii waraanaa ji'a Onkololeessaa dhaabbatee as, lubbuu namoota Palastin 1,300 ol galaafateera. Namoonni buqqa'an haleellaa waraanaa dabalaa jiru kanaan rakkoo hamaa fi sodaa jireenyaa keessa jiraatu.

title: Trump removes Syria from 'terrorism list'
english: The Trump administration has officially removed Syria from the U.S. State Sponsor of Terrorism list, ending decades of sanctions that had been in place since 1979. Secretary of State Marco Rubio also removed the terrorist designation from Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham, which is led by Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa. This decision aims to improve bilateral relations and allows for the provision of military aid, marking a major shift in U.S. foreign policy toward the Middle East.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ሶሪያን ከአሜሪካ የሽብርተኝነት ድጋፍ ሰጪ አገራት ዝርዝር ውስጥ በይፋ ሰርዟል፤ ይህም ከ1979 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ሲተገበር የነበረውን ማዕቀብ የሚያበቃ ነው። የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሩ ማርኮ ሩቢዮ የሶሪያው ፕሬዚዳንት አህመድ አል-ሻራ በሚመሩት ሃያት ታህሪር አል-ሻም ቡድን ላይ የነበረውን የሽብርተኝነት መለያም አንስተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማሻሻል እና ወታደራዊ እርዳታ ለመፍቀድ ያለመ ሲሆን፣ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ፖሊሲ ላይ ትልቅ ለውጥን ያመላክታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Donald Traamp biyya Suuriyaa tarree biyyoota shororkeessitoota deeggaran jedhamanii U.S.A biratti beekamanii keessaa haqeera. Kana waliin walqabatee, ministirri dhimma alaa Maarko Ruubiyoos gareen Hay'at Tahriir al-Shaam jedhamu kan pireezidaantii Suuriyaa Ahimad al-Shaara'aan hogganamu, tarree shororkeessitootaa keessaa akka bahu taasiseera. title: Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour dies aged 79
english: Renowned Palestinian artist Sliman Mansour has passed away at the age of 79. Over his five-decade career, he became a central figure in defining Palestinian cultural identity through his iconic paintings that featured symbols like olive trees and traditional embroidery. Beyond his artwork, he made significant contributions to the arts community by co-founding institutions dedicated to preserving Palestinian creativity and connecting artists globally.
amharic: ታዋቂው ፍልስጤማዊ ሰዓሊ ስሊማን ማንሱር በ79 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለይተዋል። ለአምስት አሥርት ዓመታት በዘለቀው የሥራ ዘመናቸው፣ የወይራ ዛፎችን እና ባህላዊ ጥልፍን የመሳሰሉ ምልክቶችን በመጠቀም የፍልስጤምን ማንነት በመግለጽ ትልቅ ሚና ተጫውተዋል። ከሥነ ጥበብ ሥራዎቻቸው በተጨማሪ የፍልስጤምን ጥበብ ለመጠበቅ እና አርቲስቶችን ለማገናኘት የሚያግዙ ተቋማትን በመመስረት ለኪነ ጥበብ ማህበረሰቡ ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ አበርክተዋል።
oromo: Artistii beekamaa Filisxeem Sliman Mansuur umuriisaa waggaa 79tti du'aan boqotee jira. Hojii isaa waggoota shantama darban keessatti, muka ejersaa fi dhawaa aadaa fayyadamuun eenyummaa Filisxeem ibsuuf gumaacha guddaa godhee ture. Hojii isaa cinaatti, dhaabbilee aartii Filisxeem eeguu fi artistoota walitti fiduu irratti hojjetan hundeessee jira.

title: What’s behind domestic political pressure on Ukraine’s president?
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is facing increased internal political tension as the war with Russia continues. While international leaders have visited to support the country's independence, Zelenskyy has dismissed suggestions to hold national elections during the ongoing conflict. His administration is also dealing with heightened scrutiny following recent corruption scandals involving high-ranking officials.

oromo: Prezidaantiin Yukireen Volodimir Zeleniski waraanni Rashiyaa wajjin itti fufaa jiruun wal qabatee dhiibbaa siyaasaa biyya keessaa mudachaa jiru. Hogganoonni idil-addunyaa biyyattii daawwatanis, Zeleniskiin yeroo waraanaatti filannoo gaggeessuuf dhiibbaa godhamu fudhatama dhabsiisaniiru. Kana malees, mootummaan isaa qorannoo malaammaltummaa hoggantoota olaanoo irratti xiyyeeffatu keessa darbaa jira.

title: Video: Iran reacts to US ‘economic D-Day’ sanctions
english: The United States has launched a new campaign of severe economic sanctions aimed at cutting off all financial support for Iran. In response, Iranian Economy Minister Ali Madani-Zadeh rejected the pressure, asserting that these efforts will not succeed. The move marks a significant escalation in ongoing tensions between the two nations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኢራንን በኢኮኖሚ ለማዳከም አዳዲስ እና ጠንካራ ማዕቀቦችን መጣሉን ይፋ አድርጓል። የኢራን የኢኮኖሚ ሚኒስትር አሊ ማዳኒ-ዛዴህ በበኩላቸው የአሜሪካን ይህን እርምጃ በመቃወም ጥረቱ ከዚህ ቀደም እንደነበረው ሁሉ ውጤታማ እንደማይሆን ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ይበልጥ ያባባሰው ተብሎ ይታሰባል።

Ministirri Diinagdee Iraan Ali Madani-Zadeh gamasaaniin, yaalii Ameerikaa kana kan morman yoo ta’u, adeemsi kun akka kanaan duraa milkaa’ina hin qabu jedhaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii gidduu jiru kan dhiphise ta’uun ibsameera.

title: Ceasefire monitoring mission arrives in Democratic Republic of Congo
english: A monitoring team has arrived in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to oversee a ceasefire between government forces and M23 rebels. Despite peace agreements mediated by Qatar, ongoing violence has persisted in the mineral-rich South Kivu region. This new mission includes representatives from both conflict parties and regional observers to verify adherence to the truce and investigate reports of violations.

oromo: Mootummaa Dimokiraatawaa Rippaabilika Kongoo keessatti waraana mootummaa fi finxaaleyyii M23 gidduutti walii galtee tasgabbii uumuuf qaamni gamaggamu tokko naannicha ga'eera. Qataariin kan gidduu galte ta'us, naannoo qabeenya uumamaa qabu kibba Kivu keessatti waraanni ammayyuu itti fufee jira. Gareen haaraan kun gam lamaaniis kan of keessatti qabatu yoo ta'u, walii galtichi akka kabajamu hordofuu fi darbiiwwan raawwataman sakatta'uuf itti gaafatamummaa qaba.

title: Displaced Palestinian builds mud shelter as tents offer little relief
english: A displaced Palestinian man has constructed a traditional mud-brick home to provide better protection for himself and his friends. This move comes as a response to the severe lack of adequate shelter in Gaza and the ongoing difficulty of obtaining standard building materials due to strict Israeli regulations. The mud structure offers a more durable alternative to the flimsy tents that fail to shield against harsh weather and potential gunfire.

title: Why do US elections cost so much money?
english: US election campaigns have become increasingly expensive, with spending rising from under $1 billion before 2010 to nearly $5 billion for the 2024 cycle. Much of this money comes from corporations and special interest groups seeking to shape public opinion through aggressive advertising and media campaigns. While significant funding often correlates with electoral success, occasional upsets occur where candidates win despite being heavily outspent.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የምርጫ ዘመቻዎች ከጊዜ ወደ ጊዜ ከፍተኛ ወጪ የሚጠይቁ ሆነዋል፣ ከ2010 በፊት ከ1 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በታች የነበረው ወጪ ለ2024 ምርጫ ወደ 5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር ደርሷል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ገንዘብ የሚመጣው በዋናነት በምርጫ ውጤት ላይ ተጽዕኖ ለመፍጠር ከሚፈልጉ ኩባንያዎች እና ልዩ ቡድኖች ነው። ምንም እንኳን ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ማግኘት ለድል ትልቅ ሚና ቢኖረውም፣ አልፎ አልፎ እጩዎች ያነሰ በጀት ይዘውም ቢሆን በምርጫ ማሸነፍ ይችላሉ።
oromo: Duulonni filannoo Yuunaayitid Isteetis keessatti gaggeeffaman baasii guddaa gaafachaa dhufeera; bara 2010 dura baasiin kun bilaayyoona tokko gadi ture, garuu bara 2024 keessa gara bilaayyoona shanitti ol guddateera. title: Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor
english: Former Liverpool midfielder Fabinho has signed a two-year contract with the Turkish club Trabzonspor. This move reunites him with his ex-teammate Mohamed Salah, who also recently joined the team. Fabinho expressed excitement about playing alongside Salah again after their successful five-year tenure together at Liverpool.
amharic: የቀድሞው የሊቨርፑል አማካይ ፋቢንሆ ከቱርኩ ትራብዞንስፖር ክለብ ጋር የሁለት ዓመት ውል ተፈራርሟል። ይህ ዝውውር ከዚህ ቀደም በሊቨርፑል አብረው ሲጫወቱ ከነበሩት መሀመድ ሳላህ ጋር እንዲገናኙ አድርጓቸዋል። ፋቢንሆ በሊቨርፑል ያሳለፉትን ስኬታማ ጊዜ ተከትሎ ከሳላህ ጋር እንደገና በመጫወቱ የተሰማውን ደስታ ገልጿል።
oromo: Gootichi taphataa Liverpool durii Fabinho kilabii Turkii Trabzonspor waliin walii galtee waggaa lamaa mallatteesseera. Tarkaanfin kun taphataa durii isaa Mohamed Salah waliin akka wal argan isa taasiseera. Fabinho Liverpoolitti waggaa shaniif waliin taphachuu isaanii booda, ammas Salah waliin taphachuu danda'uu isaatti gammachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Washington Post ordered to rehire Karen Attiah after Charlie Kirk posts
english: An independent arbitrator has ruled that the Washington Post must rehire columnist Karen Attiah and provide her with back pay. The arbiter determined that the newspaper did not have a valid reason to fire her following her social media posts about the death of Charlie Kirk. Attiah expressed relief at the decision, stating that it confirms her firing was unjust and that she was simply fulfilling her professional duties as an opinion writer.
amharic: ገለልተኛ አገናኝ ዳኛ የዋሽንግተን ፖስት ጋዜጣ አምደኛዋን ካረን አቲያን ወደ ሥራዋ እንድትመለስና የኋላ ደመወዝ እንድትከፍላት ወስኗል። ዳኛው ጋዜጣው አቲያን በቻርሊ ኪርክ ሞት ዙሪያ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በሰጠችው አስተያየት ለማባረር በቂ ምክንያት እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል። አቲያ የዚህ ውሳኔ መብለጥ ለፍትህ መቆሙንና መባረሯ ትክክል እንዳልነበረ ያረጋገጠ በመሆኑ መደሰቷን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Murtii kennituun walaba ta'e tokko gaazexaan Washington Post barreessituu Karen Attiah hojii ishee akka deebisuufi mindaa ishee kan durii akka kaffaluuf ajajeera. Madaaliin kun kan mirkanaa'e gaazexichi waa'ee du'a Charlie Kirk miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti waan barreessiteef ishee hojii irraa ari'uuf sababa ga'aa akka hin qabne erga qoratee booda dha. Attiah murticha kana erga dhageessisee booda, murtichi hojii irraa ari'amuu ishee sirrii akka hin taane kan mirkaneessuufi hojii ishee guddina garaa ishee irratti kanneen hordofan akka ta'e dubbatteetti.

title: Mexico’s president condemns governor’s brief return to office
english: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum has publicly criticized Sinaloa Governor Ruben Rocha Moya for his short-lived return to office while facing serious US drug-trafficking charges. Rocha, who initially stepped down for over three months, resumed his position briefly before requesting another leave of absence following backlash from his own political party. The president labeled his actions reckless and inappropriate, emphasizing that the interests of the nation must always take priority over personal agendas.
amharic: የሜክሲኮዋ ፕሬዝዳንት ክላውዲያ ሼይንባም በዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ዝውውር ክስ የተመሰረተባቸውን የሲናሎአ ግዛት አስተዳዳሪ ሩበን ሮቻ ሞያ ወደ ስልጣን ለመመለስ ያደረጉትን ሙከራ በይፋ ተችተዋል። ሮቻ ለአራት ወራት ያህል ከስልጣን ከራቁ በኋላ ለተወሰኑ ሰዓታት ወደ ስልጣን ተመልሰው የነበረ ቢሆንም፣ ከራሳቸው የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ በገጠማቸው ተቃውሞ ምክንያት እንደገና በዕረፍት ላይ እንዲሆኑ ተገድደዋል። ፕሬዝዳንቷ የሮቻን ድርጊት አላዋቂነት እና ተገቢ ያልሆነ በማለት በመግለጽ፣ የሀገር ጥቅም ከግል ፍላጎት በላይ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Meeksiikoo Klaawudiyaa Sheeyinbaam, bulchaan naannoo Siinaalo'aa Ruuben Rooyaa Mooyaa himata seeraa kan Ameerikaan irratti dhiyeessite osoo qabanuu gara aangoo isaatti deebi'uuf yaalii gochuun isaanii kan hin taane fi itti gaafatamummaa kan hir'isu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Bulchaan kun himata gurgurtaa qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochu irratti dhiyaateef erga ji'oota hedduuf aangoo gadi lakkisanii booda, deebi'anii aangoo fudhachuun isaanii paartii isaanii keessatti mormii guddaa uumeera. Pireezidaantiin kun gochi kun ofittummaa fi sirrii kan hin taane ta'uu ibsuudhaan, faayidaan biyyaa yeroo hunda faayidaa dhuunfaa irra akka dursu cimsee dubbataniiru.

title: Yemen’s Houthis report attack on Saudi ship
english: The Houthi rebel group in Yemen has claimed responsibility for a ballistic missile strike against a Saudi Arabian oil tanker named Amzan near the port city of Yanbu. The ship's operator, Bahri, confirmed that an incident took place but reported that all crew members are safe and unharmed. This attack is part of a series of recent Houthi strikes against Saudi vessels, raising concerns about regional stability and the flow of energy supplies.
amharic: የየመን ሁቲ አማፂያን በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ ላይ የሚሳኤል ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሳውዲው የባህር ትራንስፖርት ኩባንያ ባህሪ መርከቧ ጥቃት እንደደረሰባት ያረጋገጠ ቢሆንም፣ ሰራተኞቹ በሙሉ ደህና መሆናቸውን ገልጿል። ይህ ጥቃት በሳውዲ መርከቦች ላይ እየተደረጉ ካሉ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች አንዱ ሲሆን፣ በክልሉ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት እና የፀጥታ ሁኔታ ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humni fincilaa Huthotaa kan Yemen, doonii fe'umsa boba'aa kan Saudii Arabiyaa magaalatti Yanbuu cinaatti meeshaa waraanaatiin rukutuu isaa ibseera. Dhaabbanni doonii Saudii Bahri jedhamu, mudannoo kana mirkaneesseus, hojjattoonni doonii sun hundi miidhaa tokko malee nagaan akka jiran beeksiseera. Hojiin kunis waraana Huthotaa kanneen dooniiwwan Saudii irratti gaggeeffamaa jiran keessaa tokko ta'uun, tasgabbii naannichaa fi dhiyeessii boba'aa irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: US public approval of Iran war falls to lowest level since early days of conflict
english: A recent poll indicates that American public support for the war in Iran has dropped to 31 percent, reaching its lowest point since the start of the conflict. Additionally, President Trump’s approval rating remains stagnant at 33 percent, which is the lowest recorded during his time in office. These findings highlight a period of declining confidence regarding both current military involvement and the president's leadership.
amharic: የሮይተርስ እና ኢፕሶስ የቅርብ ጊዜ የዳሰሳ ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው በአሜሪካውያን ዘንድ ለኢራን ጦርነት ያላቸው ድጋፍ ወደ 31 በመቶ ዝቅ ብሏል፣ ይህም ከግጭቱ መጀመሪያ አንስቶ የታየው ዝቅተኛው ደረጃ ነው። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም የፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ተወዳጅነት በ33 በመቶ ላይ የቆመ ሲሆን፣ ይህም በስልጣን ዘመናቸው ከተመዘገበው ሁሉ ዝቅተኛው ነው። እነዚህ መረጃዎች በወታደራዊ ጣልቃገብነት እና በአመራሩ ላይ ያለው የህዝብ እምነት እየቀነሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Qorannoon dhihoo tureen akka ibsutti, deeggarsi ummata Ameerikaa waraana Iraan irratti qaban gara dhibbeentaa 31tti gadi bu'eera; kunis jalqaba waraanichaa irraa kaasee sadarkaa gadi aanaa dha. Kana malees, beekamtii ykn deeggarsi Preezdaant Traamp qaban dhibbeentaa 33 irra kan dhaabbate yoo ta'u, kunis yeroo isaanii keessatti sadarkaa isa gadi aanaa dha. Odeeffannoon kun hirmaannaa waraanaafi hogganummaa preezdaantichaa irratti amantaan ummataa hir'achaa dhufuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Hegseth says US not ruling out military force against Iran
english: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced that the Trump administration is keeping the option of military action against Iran open alongside new economic sanctions. While the US believes these sanctions will severely pressure Iran, Iranian officials claim they have a two-year strategy to withstand the measures. Tehran remains defiant, predicting that the American approach will ultimately fail.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ፒት ሄግሴዝ እንደገለጹት፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን አዲስ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ተከትሎ፣ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የመውሰድ አማራጭ እንደማትገዛ አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ማዕቀቡ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እንደሚፈጥር ብታምንም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ግን ችግሩን ለመቋቋም የሁለት ዓመት እቅድ እንዳላቸው በመግለጽ የአሜሪካን ጥረት ተቃውመዋል። ኢራን የአሜሪካ የጫና እርምጃ በመጨረሻ እንደሚከሽፍ ትተማመናለች።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Amerikaa Pete Hegseth akka jedhanitti, mootummaan Trump maallaqa irratti tarkaanfii haaraa fudhatus, Iran irratti duula waraanaa gaggeessuuf carraa jiru hin cufne. Amerikaan tarkaanfiin kun Iran irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uuma jedhee kan amanu yoo ta'u, mootummaan Iran garuu dhiibbaa kana dandamachuuf karoorri waggaa lamaa akka qabu ibseera. Iran gama isheetiin, tarkaanfiin Amerikaa kun bu'aa akka hin qabneefi gara fuulduraatti akka kufaatiin xumuramu amanti qabdi.

title: EU says E1 settlement plan fundamentally harms prospects for two-state solution
english: The European Union has strongly criticized Israel's plan to build over 1,200 housing units in the E1 area of the West Bank. EU officials warned that this project violates international law and would split the West Bank, making a future independent Palestinian state nearly impossible to achieve. This development is particularly concerning due to the current rise in regional violence and instability.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት በእስራኤል መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ የE1 አካባቢ ከ1,200 በላይ ቤቶችን ለመገንባት የታቀደውን ዕቅድ በፅኑ ተቃውሟል። ህብረቱ ይህ ፕሮጀክት አለም አቀፍ ህግን የሚጥስ ከመሆኑም በላይ፣ ዌስት ባንክን ለሁለት በመክፈል የወደፊት የፍልስጤም መንግስት የመመስረት ዕድልን በእጅጉ እንደሚያዳክም አስጠንቅቋል። በአካባቢው እየጨመረ የመጣው አለመረጋጋት እና የግጭት ሁኔታ ለዚህ ውሳኔ አደገኛነት ተጨማሪ ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa karoora mootummaan Israa'el naannoo E1 kan Lixaa Baankii keessatti mana jireenyaa 1,200 ol ijaaruuf qabate akka mormu ibseera. Gamtaan kun akka ibsetti, ijaarsi kun seera idil-addunyaa kan cabsuufi Lixaa Baankii bakka lamatti hiruu dhaan, biyya Palastiin kan fuulduraa ijaaruuf carraa jiru kan dhiphisu ta'uu akeekkachiiseera. Haalli kun naannicha keessatti jeequmsiifi walitti bu'iinsi dabalaa waan jiruuf yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Bessent admits sanctions may blow up global economy in apparent slip
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent inadvertently suggested that imposing immediate sanctions on Iran could destabilize the world economy. During a press briefing, he explained that the US is providing a grace period for nations to comply before potentially cutting them off from the US dollar system. He concluded his remarks abruptly and declined to take any additional questions from the press.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት በኢራን ላይ የሚጣሉ ፈጣን ማዕቀቦች የአለምን ኢኮኖሚ ሊያናጉ እንደሚችሉ በስህተት ተናግረዋል። በሰጡት ጋዜጣዊ መግለጫ ላይ ሀገራት ከማዕቀቡ ጋር እንዲላመዱ ጊዜ እንደተሰጣቸው ገልጸው፣ ይህ ካልሆነ ግን ከዶላር ስርዓት ውጭ እንደሚሆኑ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ሚኒስትሩ ይህን ከተናገሩ በኋላ ተጨማሪ ጥያቄዎችን ሳይቀበሉ ስብሰባውን ለቀው ወጥተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskootti Beesenti, Iran irratti gurgurtaa dafanii taasifamuun dinagdee addunyaa miidhuu akka danda'u dogoggoraan dubbataniiru. Ibsa gaazexeessitootaaf kennaniin, biyyoonni tarkaanfiiwwan kana akka hojiirra oolchan carraa kennamaa jiraachuu ibsanii, yoo kana hin taane garuu sirna dolaaraa keessaa akka bahaman akeekkachiisaniiru. Ministirichi yaada kana erga kennanii booda gaaffii dabalataa utuu hin deebisin walgahii sana gadi dhiisanii bahaniiru.

title: Video: Israel attacks desalination plant and mosque in Gaza
english: Israeli forces have conducted strikes against a vital water desalination facility and a mosque located in the Gaza Strip. These military actions occurred amid an ongoing period of declared ceasefire, raising concerns about the intensity of the conflict. The attacks further exacerbate the humanitarian situation for the civilians living in the enclave.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በጋዛ ሰርጥ የሚገኙ ወሳኝ የውሃ ማጣሪያ ፋብሪካ እና መስጊድ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽሟል። እነዚህ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች የተወሰደው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት በተባለበት ወቅት በመሆኑ፣ ግጭቱ አሁንም በከፍተኛ ደረጃ መቀጠሉን ያሳያል። ጥቃቶቹ በጋዛ የሚገኙ ንፁሃን ዜጎችን የሰብአዊ ሁኔታ ይበልጥ አባብሰውታል።
oromo: Humnooti Israa'el dhaabbata bishaan qulqulleessu fi masjiida magaalaa Gaazaatti argaman irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan kun yeroo humnootiin kunneen waldhabdee dhaabuuf waliigalanitti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, kunis waraanichi ammas itti fufuu isaa agarsiisa. Haleellaan kun haala jireenyaa namoota nagaa naannichaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira.

title: Israeli restrictions cause fuel shortage in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli authorities have implemented new restrictions that are severely limiting fuel supplies throughout the occupied West Bank. This measure has caused persistent shortages for Palestinians over the past several weeks. These logistical hurdles are significantly disrupting daily life and essential services in the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በያዙት እርምጃ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ከፍተኛ እገዳዎችን ጥለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ባለፉት ጥቂት ሳምንታት በፍልስጤማውያን ዘንድ የነዳጅ እጥረት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። እነዚህ መሰናክሎች በክልሉ ውስጥ ያለውን የዕለት ተዕለት እንቅስቃሴ እና መሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶችን በእጅጉ እያስተጓጎሉ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el daangaa kaasteen naannoo weeraramee jiru kan West Bank keessatti dhiyeessiin boba'aa akka addaan citu taasistee jirti. Tarkaanfiin kun torbanoota hedduuf jiraattota Falasxiin biratti hanqina boba'aa cimaa uumeera. Rakkoon kun jireenya guyyaa guyyaa fi tajaajiloota barbaachisoo ta'an irratti dhiibbaa hamaa geessisaa jira.

title: Why ‘pogrom’ best describes what’s happening in the occupied West Bank
english: The article argues that the violence carried out by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank should be classified as pogroms rather than simple riots. It contends that these assaults are systematic and often receive support from the state. By using this term, the report emphasizes that these incidents are deliberate campaigns targeting a specific minority group.
amharic: ጽሁፉ በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች በዌስት ባንክ በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚፈጸመው ጥቃት እንደ ተራ ግጭት ሳይሆን እንደ ፖግሮም (የዘር ማጥፋት ዘመቻ) መታየት እንዳለበት ይከራከራል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በተደራጀ መልኩ የሚፈጸሙ እና ብዙውን ጊዜ የመንግስት ድጋፍ ያላቸው መሆናቸውን ይገልጻል። ጸሐፊው ይህን ቃል መጠቀማቸው ጥቃቶቹ የታቀዱ እና የተወሰነ ቡድንን ለማጥቃት ያለሙ መሆናቸውን ለማጉላት ነው።
oromo: Barruun kun haleellaa warreen qubatuun Israa'el naannoo West Bank keessatti Falastinoota irratti raawwatamu, akka walitti bu'iinsa salphaatti osoo hin taane, akka ‘pogrom’ ykn haleellaa sanyii irratti xiyyeeffatuu fi gurmaa'eetti ilaalamuu akka qabu ibsa. Haleellaawwan kun haala qindaa'een kan raawwatamanii fi yeroo baay'ee deeggarsa mootummaa kan qaban ta'uu tu qixa. Jecha kana fayyadamuun, haleellaawwan kun xiyyeeffannoo fi karooraa kan qabanii fi garee xiqqaa tokko irratti kan xiyyeeffatan ta'uu ibsa.

title: Israel threatens attacks in Gaza over children’s kites
english: Israel has warned of potential military escalation and displacement in Gaza, characterizing the use of children's kites as acts of war. Palestinian analysts have dismissed these claims as unfounded and argue they serve as a pretext for further aggression. This development has raised concerns about the potential for increased violence in the region.
amharic: እስራኤል የጋዛ ህጻናት የሚጫወቱባቸውን ካይቶች (የወረቀት አውሮፕላን) እንደ ጦርነት ድርጊት በመፈረጅ፣ ጥቃቶችን እንደምታጠናክርና ሰዎችን እንደምታፈናቅል አስጠንቅቃለች። የፍልስጤም ተንታኞች ይህንን ክስ መሠረተ ቢስ ነው ሲሉ ያጣጣሉት ሲሆን፣ እስራኤል ለተጨማሪ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ሰበብ ለመፍጠር እየተጠቀመችበት እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በክልሉ የጦርነት ውጥረት እንዲባባስ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Israa'el daa'imman Gaazaa keessatti kaaytee (koollee) taphatan akka gocha waraanaatti lakkaawuun, haleellaa jabeeessuu fi namoota buqqisuun akka ishee sodaachistu beeksisite. Xiinxaltoonni Falasxiin himannaa kana kan dhugaa irratti hin hundoofneefi Israa'el haleellaa caaluuf sababa barbaaduuf kan fayyadamtu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Gochi kun naannichatti waraana fi miidhaan akka dabalu sodaachiseera.

title: Iran has a 'two year plan' to counter sanctions, economic minister says
english: The Iranian Minister of Economy recently announced that the government has prepared a comprehensive two-year strategy to mitigate the impact of new American sanctions. Officials expressed confidence that these measures will allow the country to withstand external pressure. They further claimed that previous international attempts to weaken Iran's economy have ultimately failed.
amharic: የኢራን የኢኮኖሚ ሚኒስትር አዲሱ የአሜሪካ ማዕቀብ የሚያስከትለውን ጫና ለመቋቋም የሚያስችል የሁለት ዓመት እቅድ መዘጋጀቱን አስታውቀዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ እነዚህ ስልቶች ሀገሪቱ በኢኮኖሚው ላይ የሚደርሰውን ጫና እንድትቋቋም እንደሚረዷት ገልጸዋል። ከዚህ ቀደም የኢራንን ኢኮኖሚ ለማዳከም የተሞከሩ ሙከራዎች ሁሉ ከሽፈዋል ሲሉም አክለዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dinagdee Iraan mootummaan isaanii adabbii haaraa Ameerikaan irra keesse of irraa ittisuuf karoorri waggaa lamaa qophaa'uu ibseera. Hojjettoonni mootummaa qophiin kun miidhaa diinagdee dhaqqachuu danda'u dandamachuuf akka gargaaru amantii qabu. Kana dura carraaqqiin biyyoota alaa diinagdee Iraan laaffisuuf godhan hundi milkaa'ina akka hin arganne ibsaniiru.

title: Trump unleashes swathe of sanctions on Iran 'enablers'
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has introduced a new round of severe sanctions targeting Iran and its international supporters to further pressure the regime. Labeled Operation Economic Outcast, the plan aims to eliminate Iranian oil smuggling networks and force countries to cut financial ties with Tehran. While specific nations and entities were not named, the US government has warned that any international financial institutions or businesses continuing to work with Iran will face harsh consequences.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት ኢራንን እና ደጋፊዎቿን ለማዳከም የታለሙ አዳዲስ እና ከፍተኛ ማዕቀቦችን ይፋ አድርገዋል። ኦፕሬሽን ኢኮኖሚክ አውትካስት በተባለው በዚህ እቅድ፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራንን የነዳጅ ማዘዋወሪያ መስመሮች በመዝጋት እና ከቴህራን ጋር የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነት ያላቸውን ሀገራት በመጫን አገሪቱን ለማግለል እየሰራ ነው። ማዕቀቡ በየትኞቹ ሀገራት እና ተቋማት ላይ እንደሚጣል በግልጽ ባይጠቀስም፣ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነታቸውን የማያቋርጡ አካላት ከባድ እርምጃ እንደሚወሰድባቸው ማስጠንቀቂያ ተሰጥቷል።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqaa Ameerikaa Iskoott Besenti, mootummaa Iraan fi deggertoota ishee irratti uggura diinagdee cimaa ta'e kan haaraa labsan. 'Operation Economic Outcast' kan jedhame kun, Iraan boba'aa seeraan ala gurguruu fi hariiroo diinagdee addunyaa waliin qabdu akka cufattu dirqisiisuuf kan kaayyeffate dha. Mootummaan Ameerikaa biyyoota ykn dhaabbilee Iraan waliin hojjetan kamiyyuu irratti tarkaanfiin cimaan akka fudhatamu akeekkachiiseera, garuu biyyoonni uggurichi isaaniin ilaallatu sun eenyu akka ta'an ifa hin godhin.

title: Trump administration seeks to formalise H-1B fee of more than $100,000
english: The Trump administration is attempting to permanently set a $103,265 fee for H-1B work visas used by the tech and research industries. This proposal aims to replace a previous temporary rule that was blocked by federal courts after being deemed illegal. If finalized following a 30-day public feedback period, this massive cost increase would make it significantly more expensive for American companies to hire skilled foreign professionals.
amharic: የዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በቴክኖሎጂ እና በምርምር ዘርፎች የሚቀጠሩ የውጭ ሀገር ሰራተኞች የሚጠቀሙበትን የኤች-1ቢ (H-1B) የቪዛ ክፍያ ወደ 103,265 ዶላር ለማሳደግ እና በቋሚነት ተግባራዊ ለማድረግ አቅዷል። ይህ ሀሳብ ከዚህ ቀደም በፍርድ ቤት የታገደውን ጊዜያዊ ህግ ለመተካት ያለመ ነው። የ30 ቀናት የህዝብ አስተያየት ጊዜ ካለፈ በኋላ ህጉ ተግባራዊ ከሆነ፣ የአሜሪካ ኩባንያዎች የውጭ ሀገር ባለሙያዎችን ለመቅጠር የሚያወጡት ወጪ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ይጨምራል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi Donald Trump baasii viizaa hojii H-1B kan damee teeknooloojii fi qorannoo keessatti fayyadamamu gara doolaara 103,265 tti ol kaasuuf fi akkaataa dhaabbataa ta'een hojiirra oolchuuf karoorfateera. Karoorri kun seera kanaan dura mana murtii federaalaatiin dhorkame bakka buusuuf kan yaadeedha. Yeroon yaada uummataa guyyaa 30 erga xumuramee booda, seera kanaan hojiirra oolchuun, kampaanonni Ameerikaa ogeeyyoota biyya alaa qacaruuf baasii guddaa akka baasan taasisa.

title: Norway plans further development of Arctic drilling amid EU energy concerns
english: Norway intends to keep expanding its oil and gas drilling in the Arctic, specifically the Barents Sea, to help meet European energy demands. Although the European Union has previously pushed for a ban on Arctic drilling for environmental reasons, it is reconsidering this stance due to global energy security threats. Norwegian officials argue that these activities are essential for the continent's stability and believe the industry will remain viable even if EU policies shift.
amharic: ኖርዌይ የአውሮፓን የኃይል ፍላጎት ለማሟላት በአርክቲክ ክልል በተለይም በባረንትስ ባህር ውስጥ የነዳጅ እና ጋዝ ስራዎችን ማስፋፋቷን ለመቀጠል አቅዳለች። አውሮፓ ህብረት ከዚህ ቀደም በአካባቢ ጥበቃ ምክንያት በአርክቲክ አካባቢ አዲስ የቁፋሮ ስራዎች እንዲከለከሉ ቢፈልግም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ባለው የዓለም አቀፍ የኃይል አቅርቦት ስጋት ምክንያት አቋሙን እየገመገመ ይገኛል። የኖርዌይ ባለስልጣናት ይህ የቁፋሮ ስራ ለአውሮፓ የኃይል ደህንነት ወሳኝ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ፕሮጀክቶቹ ተገቢ መሆናቸውን ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Norweeyn fedhii anniisaa Awurooppaa guutuuf jecha, naannoo Arktik keessatti keessattuu galaana Baarentsitti hojiin baasii boba'aa fi gaazii akka itti fufu karoorsiteetti. Gamtaan Awurooppaa kanaan dura sababa eegumsa naannootiin qodduu haaraa akka hin gaggeeffamne barbaadaa ture, garuu ammaa ammaa rakkoo nageenya anniisaa addunyaa irraa kan ka'e yaada isaa irra deebiin ilaalaa jira. Hoji gaggeessitoonni Norweey hojiin kun nageenya anniisaa Awurooppaaf baayyee barbaachisaa ta'uu fi hojiin kun haala kanaan itti fufuun isaa sirrii ta'uu dubbatu.

title: Israeli forces raid village in Syria’s Quneitra governorate
english: Israeli military forces entered the village of Saida al-Golan, located in Syria’s Quneitra region, this past Monday. During the operation, soldiers conducted searches at a local farm near the settlement. Syrian media outlets reported the incident, though details on the purpose of the raid remain limited.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ሰኞ ዕለት በሶሪያ ኩኒትራ ግዛት በምትገኘው ሰይዳ አል-ጎላን መንደር ገብተው ነበር። በኦፕሬሽኑ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ በመንደሩ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ እርሻ ላይ ፍተሻ አድርገዋል። የሶሪያ መገናኛ ብዙኃን ይህንን ክስተት የዘገቡ ሲሆን ስለ ወረራው ዓላማ እስካሁን የታወቀ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Humnootni waraana Israa'el ganda Sa'ida al-Golan kan naannoo Quneitra, Siiriyaa keessatti argamtu Dilbata darbe seenanii turan. Humni kun gandattii keessatti qonna tokko irratti sakatta'iinsa geggeessaniiru. Miidiyaaleen Siiriyaa akka gabaasanitti, gochi kun kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, kaayyoon duula kanaa hanga ammaa ifa hin taane.

title: Iran Parliament Speaker: US not in an economic position to impose more restrictions on other countries
english: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf claimed that the United States lacks the economic strength to successfully enforce further global sanctions. This statement follows threats from the U.S. Treasury to penalize nations that conduct financial dealings with Iran. Ghalibaf asserted that Iran's trade partners are ignoring these American warnings and continue to maintain their relationships with Tehran.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ፣ አሜሪካ አዳዲስ ዓለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦችን ለመጫን የሚያስችል የኢኮኖሚ አቅም እንደሌላት ተናገሩ። ይህ አስተያየት የተሰጠው የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስቴር ከኢራን ጋር የገንዘብ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሀገራት ላይ እርምጃ እንደሚወስድ ካስጠነቀቀ በኋላ ነው። ጋሊባፍ እንዳሉት የኢራን የንግድ አጋሮች የአሜሪካን ማስፈራሪያ ችላ በማለት ግንኙነታቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mana maree Iran Mohammad Baager Gaalibaaft akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan biyyoota biroo irratti uggura diinagdee dabalataa kaa'uuf dandeettii diinagdee hin qabdu. ibsi kun kan kenname waajjirri baajata Ameerikaa biyyoota Iran waliin daldalan irratti tarkaanfiin akka fudhatamu erga akeekkachiisee boodadha. Gaalibaaft akka jedhanitti, hiriyoonni daldalaa Iran akeekkachiisa Ameerikaa kana hojii irra hin oolchan akkasumas hariiroo isaanii itti fufuuf murteessaniiru.

title: Kidnappers release video showing hundreds abducted from Nigerian mosque
english: Armed kidnappers have released a video showing approximately 600 people abducted from a mosque in Nigeria’s Niger state. Local residents have confirmed the identities of family members in the footage, which shows captives being held in a forest. This incident highlights the worsening security situation in Nigeria ahead of the upcoming presidential elections.
amharic: ታጣቂዎች በናይጄሪያ የኒጀር ግዛት ከሚገኝ መስጊድ ከ600 በላይ ሰዎችን ጠልፈው የያዙበትን ቪዲዮ ይፋ አድርገዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች በጫካ ውስጥ ታግተው የሚታዩትን ዘመዶቻቸውን በቪዲዮው ማወቃቸውን አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ አፈና በሀገሪቱ በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ዋዜማ የጸጥታ ችግሩን አሳሳቢነት በማጋለጥ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hattuuwwan meeshaan hidhatan namoota 600 ol ta'an naannoo Niijer kan biyya Naayijeeriyaa keessatti masjiida tokko keessaa butuunsaanii viidiyoo ba'een mirkanaa'eera. Jiraattonni naannichaa namoota bosona keessatti hidhamanii jiran keessatti firoottan isaanii beekuu mirkaneessaniiru. Gochi kun filannoo biyyattii dhufuuf jedhuun walqabatee rakkoon nageenyaa Naayijeeriyaa keessatti bal'achaa jiraachuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump administration announces global economic war on Iran
english: The Trump administration has launched an aggressive economic campaign against Iran aimed at cutting off all of the country's primary revenue streams, particularly oil exports. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent described this initiative as an unprecedented economic war. The U.S. government has also cautioned that any nations continuing to engage in trade with Tehran will face serious repercussions.
amharic: የ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በኢራን ላይ ሁሉንም የገቢ ምንጮች፣ በተለይም የነዳጅ ንግድን የሚያግድ ሰፊ የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነት አውጇል። የገንዘብ ሚኒስትሩ ስኮት ቤሰንት ይህንን እርምጃ ከዚህ በፊት ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የኢኮኖሚ ጦርነት ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። በተጨማሪም አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነታቸውን የሚቀጥሉ ሀገራት ከባድ መዘዝ እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠንቅቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Trump tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa Iran irratti fudhachuu beeksiseera; kunis maddi galii biyyattii hundaa keessattuu kan boba’aa dhaabuuf kan kaayyeffate dha. Ministirri maallaqaa Scott Bessent tarkaanfichaa waraana diinagdee kan kanaan dura hin beekamne jechuun ibsaniiru. Kana malees, Ameerikaan biyyoonni Iran waliin daldala itti fufan hundi adabbii cimaaf akka saaxilaman akeekkachiisteetti.

title: Japanese delegation seeks to soothe strained ties with China
english: A group of Japanese lawmakers has traveled to Beijing to begin talks aimed at repairing diplomatic and economic ties with China. Relations between the two countries reached their lowest point since 1972 following controversial remarks by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi regarding Taiwan. This visit seeks to reopen communication channels that were closed by China in response to the dispute, which has negatively impacted trade and economic cooperation.
amharic: የጃፓን የህግ አውጭዎች ቡድን ከቻይና ጋር ያላቸውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ግንኙነት ለማደስ ወደ ቤጂንግ ተጉዘዋል። በታይዋን ጉዳይ ላይ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሳናኤ ታካኢቺ የሰጡትን አወዛጋቢ አስተያየት ተከትሎ፣ የሁለቱ አገራት ግንኙነት ከ1972 ወዲህ ወደ ታችኛው ደረጃ ወርዶ ነበር። የዚህ ጉብኝት ዋና ዓላማ በችግሩ ምክንያት የተቋረጡትን የሁለትዮሽ የውይይት መስመሮች እንደገና በመክፈት የተፈጠረውን የንግድ እና የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ማርገብ ነው።
oromo: Miseensonni seera baastoota Jaappaan tokko hariiroo diippiloomaasii fi diinagdee Chaayinaa wajjin qaban fooyyessuuf gara Beejiing imalaniiru. Hariiroon biyyoota lamaanii kan daangeffamee fi miidhaan irra ga'e, yeroo muummee ministiraa Saanaa Taaka'iichii waa'ee Taayiwaan ibsa mormii kaase kennan ture. Imalli kun hariiroo cimaa ta'e kana furuufi karaalee dubbii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti cufame turan deebisanii banuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Trump administration announces ‘economic D-day’ sanctions on Iran
english: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has launched a new campaign of aggressive sanctions, titled 'Operation Economic Outcast,' aimed at isolating Iran and cutting off its global revenue streams. The initiative explicitly threatens secondary penalties against any nations or businesses that continue to trade with Tehran, particularly concerning oil exports. This move follows ongoing military tensions and seeks to force Iran into major concessions, including the abandonment of its nuclear program.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት ኢራንን ለመነጠል እና የገቢ ምንጮቿን ለማቋረጥ ያለመ 'ኢኮኖሚክ አውትካስት' የተሰኘ አዲስ የተጠናከረ ማዕቀብ ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ከቴህራን ጋር የንግድ ልውውጥ የሚያደርጉ፣ በተለይም የነዳጅ ግብይት ላይ የተሰማሩ አገራት እና ኩባንያዎች በቅጣት እንደሚጠየቁ ያስጠነቅቃል። ይህ ዘመቻ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ካለው ወታደራዊ ውጥረት ጋር ተያይዞ ኢራን የኑክሌር መርሃ ግብሯን እንድታቆም እና ሌሎች ስምምነቶችን እንድትቀበል ለማስገደድ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Maallaqa Ameerikaa Iskootti Besenti, Iran addunyaarraa addaan baasuufi madda galii ishee cufuuf tarkaanfii dinagdee haaraa 'Operation Economic Outcast' jedhamu labseera. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyootaafi dhaabbatoota Iran waliin daldalan, keessattuu kan boba'aa bitanirratti adabbii cimaa akka fudhatu akeekkachiiseera. Duulli kun walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa erga eegalee booda, Iran sagantaa niwuukilaraa ishee akka dhiistufi fedhii Ameerikaa akka fudhattu dirqisiisuuf kan karoorfamedha.

title: US announces 'unprecedented' sanctions against Iran
english: The United States has launched a significant new wave of sanctions targeting Iran’s aviation, shipping, gold, and technology sectors, affecting nearly 60 individuals and organizations. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent warned that nations and businesses must stop interacting with Tehran or risk being cut off from the American financial system. President Trump is actively pressuring global leaders to isolate Iran economically, with plans to sanction a major financial institution soon.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአይራን የአቪዬሽን፣ የመርከብ፣ የወርቅ እና የቴክኖሎጂ ዘርፎች ላይ ያነጣጠረ አዲስ ማዕቀብ መጣሏን አስታውቃለች፤ ይህም ወደ 60 የሚጠጉ ግለሰቦችና ተቋማት ላይ ተጽዕኖ ይኖረዋል። የአሜሪካ ግምጃ ቤት ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት እንደተናገሩት፣ ከኢራን ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው አገራትና ኩባንያዎች ይህን ካላቆሙ ከአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሥርዓት እንደሚታገዱ አስጠንቅቀዋል። ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕም ኢራንን ኢኮኖሚያዊ በሆነ መንገድ ለማግለል ከዓለም መሪዎች ጋር እየተወያዩ ሲሆን፣ በቅርቡም አንድ ትልቅ የገንዘብ ተቋም ማዕቀብ እንደሚጣልበት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Amerikaa mootummaa Iraan irratti tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa fudhachuu ishee beeksisteerti; kunis dameewwan xiyyaaraa, doonii, warqee fi teeknoolojii kan ilaallatu yoo ta'u, namoota fi dhaabbilee 60 ta'an irratti dhiibbaa uuma. Ministirri maallaqaa Amerikaa Skot Besent, biyyoonni ykn dhaabbileen Iraan waliin hojjetan yoo dhaabuu baatan sirna maallaqaa Amerikaa keessaa akka baafaman akeekkachiisaniiru. Prezidaant Traamp Iraan diinagdeen addunyaa irraa akka adda baatuuf hoogganoota biyyoota addunyaa waliin mari'achaa jiran, torban kana keessas dhaabbata maallaqaa guddaa tokko irratti adabbii buusuuf qophaa'aa jiru.

title: Nearly one in two Ebola patients dying in DR Congo outbreak
english: Official data from the Democratic Republic of the Congo reveals that the current Ebola outbreak has reached a critical stage, with nearly half of those infected losing their lives. This health crisis is now officially recorded as the most lethal Ebola epidemic in the nation’s history. Authorities are highlighting the severity of the situation as the disease continues to take a significant toll on the population.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ እየተከሰተ ያለው የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ እጅግ አደገኛ ደረጃ ላይ ደርሷል፤ ይህም በበሽታው ከተያዙት ሰዎች መካከል ወደ ግማሽ የሚጠጉት ለህልፈት እንዲዳረጉ አድርጓል። የመንግስት መረጃዎች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ ይህ ወረርሽኝ በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ ውስጥ እጅግ አስከፊው የኢቦላ መቅሰፍት ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል። የበሽታው ስርጭት አስጊ ደረጃ ላይ በመድረሱ በህዝቡ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል።
oromo: Dhibee Eebolaa biyya Koongoo Dimookiraatawaa keessatti hammaataa jiruun, namoonni dhibichaan qabaman keessaa walakkaan isaanii du’aa jiru. Ragaan mootummaan baase akka agarsiisutti, tattaaffiin kun seenaa biyyattii keessatti dhibee Eebolaa hunda caalaa lubbuu galaafate ta’eera. Haalli kun yaaddessaa ta’ee itti fufuun namoota baay’ee irratti miidhaa guddaa gahaa jira.

title: Russia to seize poorly protected infrastructure as Ukraine barrage persists
english: President Vladimir Putin has authorized the Russian state to take temporary control of critical infrastructure facilities that fail to protect themselves against Ukrainian drone strikes. This decree allows the government to seize management of energy, transport, and logistics sites if owners are unable to secure their properties or repair damage efficiently. The measure follows a series of successful long-range attacks by Ukraine that have caused significant economic disruption and fuel shortages across Russia.
amharic: የሩሲያ ፕሬዝዳንት ቭላዲሚር ፑቲን የዩክሬን የድሮን ጥቃቶችን ለመከላከል አቅም የሌላቸውን ወሳኝ የመሠረተ ልማት ተቋማት መንግስት በጊዜያዊነት እንዲቆጣጠር የሚያስችል አዋጅ አጽድቀዋል። በዚህ አዋጅ መሰረት የግል ባለቤቶች ንብረታቸውን መጠበቅ ወይም የደረሰባቸውን ጉዳት በፍጥነት መጠገን ካልቻሉ፣ መንግስት የኢነርጂ፣ የትራንስፖርት እና የሎጂስቲክስ ማዕከላትን መረከብ ይችላል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ኢኮኖሚ እና ነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰች በመሆኑ ነው።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Raashiyaa Vlaadimiir Puutiin, dhaabbileen bu'uuraalee misoomaa weeraraa uummatta Yukreeniif hin mijanne ykn of eeggannoo cimaa hin godhanne hundi to'annoo mootummaa jala akka galan ajaja baasaniiru. Ajajni kun qabiyyee ykn faayidaalee humna ibsaa, geejjibaa fi logistiksii kanneen qabiyyoon isaanii of eeggannoo ga’aa hin goone ykn miidhaa irra ga’e battalumatti suphuu hin dandeenye irratti mootummaan akka bobba’u heyyama. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame Yukreen iddoo iddoo gurguddaa Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa raawwattuun diinagdee fi dhiyeessii boba’aa biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumuu ishee hordofeeti.

title: Former snooker world champion Graeme Dott convicted of child sex abuse
english: Former world snooker champion Graeme Dott has been found guilty in a Scottish court of sexually abusing a young girl and a boy between 1993 and 2010. The 49-year-old athlete faced multiple charges related to inappropriate sexual behavior and assault, all of which he denied before his conviction. A judge is expected to determine his sentence for these crimes next month.
amharic: የቀድሞው የዓለም ስኑከር ሻምፒዮን ግሬም ዶት በ1993 እና በ2010 መካከል በአንድ ህጻን ሴት ልጅ እና ወንድ ልጅ ላይ ወሲባዊ ጥቃት ፈጽሟል በሚል በስኮትላንድ ፍርድ ቤት ጥፋተኛ ሆኖ ተገኝቷል። የ49 ዓመቱ ስፖርተኛ በበርካታ የፆታ ጥቃት ክሶች ተከሶ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ክሱን ቢክድም ፍርድ ቤቱ ጥፋተኛ ብሎታል። ዳኛው ለፈጸመው ወንጀል የሚወስንበትን ቅጣት በሚቀጥለው ወር ይፋ ያደርጋሉ ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Goontichi isnuukarii addunyaa duraanii Gireem Doot, gidduu bara 1993 fi 2010 tti ijoollee durbaa fi dhiiraa irratti miidhaa saalqunnamtii raawwateera jechuun mana murtii Iskootlaandiin yakkaamuu isaa murteesseera. Ispoortiiwwaan waggaa 49 kun himata hedduu irratti dhihaate haaluus, mana murtichatti yakkaamuu isaa irratti murteeffameera. Manni murtichaa adabbii isaa baatii dhufu keessa kan murteessu ta'a.

title: Israeli strike on Gaza shelter extends casualty list
english: An Israeli airstrike targeting a shelter in central Gaza has resulted in at least one death and multiple injuries. The Israeli military claimed the strike aimed at Hamas militants who were reportedly violating the terms of the existing ceasefire. Since the conflict began in October 2023, the death toll in Gaza has risen to over 73,000, including more than 1,200 casualties since the ceasefire agreement took effect.
amharic: በመካከለኛው ጋዛ በተጠለሉ ተፈናቃዮች ላይ የተፈጸመ የእስራኤል የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው ሲገደል ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል። እስራኤል ጥቃቱን ያደረሰችው የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን በመጣስ ላይ ያሉ የሃማስ ታጣቂዎችን ኢላማ ለማድረግ እንደሆነ ገልጻለች። ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ በተቀሰቀሰው ጦርነት የሟቾች ቁጥር ከ73,000 በላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን፣ ከተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱ ወዲህ ብቻ ከ1,200 በላይ ሰዎች ህይወታቸውን አጥተዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el iddoo buqqaatonni Gazaatti itti qubatanii jiran irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraan raawwateen namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni biroon hedduun madaa'aniiru. Israa'el haleellaa kana kan raawwatte miseensota Hamas waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaa cabsan irratti xiyyeeffachuun akka ta'e ibsiteetti. Waraana Sadaasa 2023 irraa jalqabee kaasee namoonni 73,000 ol du'aniiru; waliigaltee dhaabbii waraanaatti boodas namoonni 1,200 ol ta'an lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: Gaza death toll rises to 8
english: Israeli military airstrikes in central and southern Gaza have resulted in the deaths of at least eight Palestinians, including two children. The attacks have caused significant destruction to civilian infrastructure, including homes, mosques, and a water treatment plant. Local medical authorities confirmed these casualties following the raids that occurred on Monday.
amharic: በጋዛ መካከለኛ እና ደቡባዊ ክፍሎች በእስራኤል በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ሁለት ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ተገድለዋል። ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን፣ መስጊዶችን እና የውሃ ማጣሪያ ጣቢያን ጨምሮ በርካታ መሰረተ ልማቶችን አውድሟል። የህክምና ባለሙያዎች በሰኞው ጥቃት የተጎጂዎቹ ቁጥር መጨመሩን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el iddoowwan giddugaleessa fi kibba Gaazaatti haleellaa xiyyaaraan geggeessaniin ijoollee lama dabalatee namoonni saddeet ol du'aniiru. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa, masjiidota fi iddoo bishaan qulqulleessan dabalatee bu'uuraalee misoomaa gurguddaa miidheera. Ogeeyyiin fayyaa akka ibsanitti, miidhaan kun kan hammaate guyyaa Wiixataa erga haleellaan kun jalqabee booda dha.

title: Israel launches strikes across southern Lebanon
english: The Israeli military conducted several airstrikes on Monday near two villages in southern Lebanon's Bint Jbeil district. During the operation, an Israeli drone also detonated near construction equipment being used to clear debris from a previous strike. There have been no immediate updates regarding injuries or fatalities following these events.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር ሰኞ ዕለት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኙ ሁለት መንደሮች አቅራቢያ በርካታ የአየር ጥቃቶችን ፈጽሟል። በጥቃቱ ወቅት የአንድ የእስራኤል ድሮን በተበላሸ ሕንጻ ፍርስራሽ ላይ ሲሰራ የነበረ ማሽነሪ አቅራቢያ መፈንዳቱ ተዘግቧል። እስካሁን በደረሰው ጉዳት ዙሪያ ምንም አይነት የሟቾች ወይም የቁስለኞች መረጃ አልወጣም።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el Wiixata darbe kibba Libaanositti baadiyyaalee lama biratti weerara qilleensa irraa raawwateera. Duula kana keessatti, dooniin Israa'el tokko meeshaa ijaarsaa sigiga diigamaa qulqulleessaa ture biratti dho'ateera. Taateewwan kanaan walqabatee namootni miidhaman ykn lubbuun darbe hanga ammaatti kan hin gabaafamne yoo ta'u, qulqulleessiin dhimma kanaa itti fufeera.

title: Iranian and Pakistani top officials meet in Tehran
english: Pakistan's military leader, Asim Munir, held discussions with Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf in Tehran this Monday. The officials focused on the United States' failure to honor agreements related to a previous memorandum of understanding between the two nations. Ghalibaf criticized American actions for undermining regional stability, while Munir pledged to keep working toward peace in the area.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የጦር ኃይሎች አዛዥ አሲም ሙኒር ሰኞ ዕለት በቴህራን ከኢራን የፓርላማ አፈ-ጉባኤ መሐመድ ባጌር ጋሊባፍ ጋር ተገናኝተው ተወያይተዋል። በውይይታቸው ወቅት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ቀደም ሲል በተደረገ የመግባቢያ ስምምነት ላይ አሜሪካ የገባችውን ቃል ባለመጠበቋ የተፈጠረውን ችግር አንስተዋል። ጋሊባፍ የአሜሪካ ድርጊት ለቀጣናው ሰላም መደፍረስ ምክንያት መሆኑን ሲገልጹ፣ ሙኒር በበኩላቸው በክልሉ መረጋጋትን ለመፍጠር ጥረታቸውን እንደሚቀጥሉ አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Paakistaan Asim Munir Wiixata darbe Tehraanitti gahi'anii gorsaa fi dubbi himaa paarlamaa Iraan Mohaammad Baageer Gaalibaaf waliin mari'ataniiru. Mariin isaanii irratti walii galtee biyyoota lamaan gidduutti duraan mallatteeffame irratti Ameerikaan waadaa galte cabsuun ishee rakkoo akka uume kaasuun irratti mari'ataniiru. Gaalibaaf gochi Ameerikaa kun nageenya naannichaa akka booressu ibsan; gama biraatiin ammoo, Munir naannichatti tasgabbii deebisuuf carraaqqii isaanii akka itti fufan ibsaniiru.

title: Nathan Cofnas on whether he feels responsible for Jason Arday’s death
english: Academic Nathan Cofnas recently gave his first interview following the death of Jason Arday, the youngest Black professor at Cambridge University. During the discussion, Cofnas was directly questioned about his potential role in the professor's passing. This follows previous controversy where Cofnas had accused Arday of plagiarism.
amharic: አካዳሚክ ናታን ኮፍናስ የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲው ወጣት ጥቁር ፕሮፌሰር ጄሰን አርዳይ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ከተለዩ በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ቃለ መጠይቅ አድርገዋል። በቃለ መጠይቁ ወቅት፣ ለፕሮፌሰሩ ሞት ተጠያቂነት ይሰማዎት እንደሆነ ጥያቄ ቀርቦላቸዋል። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው ኮፍናስ ቀደም ሲል በአርዳይ ላይ የክህደት (plagiarism) ክስ አቅርበው በነበረበት ወቅት በተፈጠረው ውዝግብ ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Hayyuun barnootaa Naataan Kofnaas, piroofeesara gurraacha ganna xiqqaa Yuunivarsiitii Kaambirij kan ta'an Jeeson Ardaay erga du'anii booda yeroo jalqatiif gaafatamanii jiru. Marii kana irratti, Kofnaas du'a piroofeesarichaa irratti gahee qabu ilaalchisee gaaffiin irra deddeebi'amee gaafatamee jira. Kunis kan ta'e, kanaan dura Kofnaas piroofeesar Ardaay irratti himata hatuu hojii nama biraa (plagiarism) dhiyeessuun isaanii kan yaadatamu dha.

title: England drop fast bowler Bryden Carse amid investigation into club incident
english: England cricket officials have removed fast bowler Brydon Carse from the squad for the upcoming second Test against Pakistan. This decision follows an ongoing investigation into a recent incident at a club in Derby involving the player. Carse will remain unavailable for selection while authorities work to determine the full facts of the situation.

oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa kirikeetii Ingiliz, taphataa ariifataa diraayid Kaarsiin tapha lammaffaa Paakistaan waliin godhamuuf jiru keessaa dhaabaniiru. Murteen kun kan dabare, magaalaa Darbii keessatti bakka bashannanaa tokko keessatti waan uumame tokko irratti qorannoon gaggeeffamaa waan jiruufi. Hanga qorannoon kun xumuramee dhugaan isaa gadi ba'utti, taphatichi garee kana keessatti akka hin hirmaanne murtaa'eera.

title: What to expect as Iran braces for new US economic measures amid war
english: The United States is preparing to impose a new round of severe economic sanctions against Iran, aiming to collapse its government and economy. While Washington plans to target banks, oil exports, and shipping networks, experts doubt these measures will successfully force a change in Iran's political behavior. In response, Tehran is relying on land trade routes and a sophisticated system of sanctions evasion to mitigate the impact, though ordinary citizens are expected to suffer the most from these escalating tensions.

title: Trump slams Canada with new 50 percent auto tariffs for 2027
english: President Trump has announced a significant 50 percent tariff on Canadian automobiles and vehicle parts starting in 2027 following the collapse of recent trade negotiations. He stated that these measures are intended to encourage domestic manufacturing, despite warnings from industry experts that such duties could disrupt American car production. This escalation marks a major shift in the economic relationship between the two nations, which have historically been close trading partners.

oromo: Pirezedaanti Traamp mariin daldalaa kanaan dura adeemsifamaa ture erga fashaleen booda, bara 2027 irraa eegalee mootummaan isaanii konkolaattotaafi meeshaalee konkolaataa Kaanaadaa irraa dhufan hunda irratti gibira dhibbeentaa 50 akka kaa'u beeksisaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qorqodduuwwan Ameerikaa keessatti akka oomishan jajjabeessuuf kan yaadame ta'us, ogeeyyonni damee kanaa gibirri kun oomisha konkolaataa Ameerikaa irratti rakkoo guddaa akka uumu akeekkachiisaniiru. Murteen kun hariiroo daldala biyyoota lamaanii kan kanaan dura ture sana jijjiiruu danda'a.

title: Are humanoid robots the future of warfare?
english: Humanoid robots are rapidly advancing in their capabilities, moving from athletic achievements to being actively tested for military applications. Governments and private entities are investing heavily in these machines to explore their potential roles on the battlefield. This trend marks a significant shift in the global technology race, raising questions about the future of modern warfare.

title: Video: Russia launches rocket into space with military satellite
english: Russia has successfully sent a military satellite into orbit using a Soyuz-2.1 rocket launched from the Arkhangelsk region. Military analysts suggest that this technology is intended to boost surveillance capabilities over Ukraine. This move is viewed as a strategic effort to improve the country's situational awareness during the ongoing conflict.

title: UK to help Ukraine build Storm Shadow long-range missiles: Why it matters
english: The United Kingdom has agreed to provide Ukraine with classified technical details to help the country manufacture its own Storm Shadow long-range cruise missiles. During his first visit to Kyiv, Prime Minister Andy Burnham reaffirmed Britain's commitment to supporting Ukraine's defense independence amidst the ongoing war. This decision marks a significant shift in military support, as it allows Ukraine to sustain its fighting capabilities even as international backing from other allies remains uncertain.

title: IRGC says Iran will target ‘US energy chokepoints’ if attacked
english: A spokesperson for Iran's Revolutionary Guard warned that if Iranian infrastructure is hit, the country will retaliate by attacking American energy hubs and key interests. The official emphasized that Iran maintains a robust supply of smart missiles to carry out such strikes. This statement serves as a direct threat against United States assets in the event of a military escalation.

Akeekkachiisni kun walitti bu'iinsa waraanaa yoo uumame tarkaanfii Iran fudhachuu dandeessu kan ibsuudha.

title: Israeli spy Jonathan Pollard wants Iran ‘off the map’, says wars on Turkey and Egypt are next
english: Jonathan Pollard, a former Israeli spy, is advocating for aggressive military action against Iran while labeling Egypt and Turkey as future strategic threats to Israel. As he runs for a seat in the Knesset, he argues that Israel must neutralize these regional powers to avoid a dangerous security situation. His remarks are notable given that both Egypt and Turkey currently maintain diplomatic ties with Israel.

title: Four Palestinians killed by Israeli forces in Gaza, including young girl
english: Four Palestinians, including a young girl, were killed in separate Israeli military operations across the Gaza Strip on Monday. Casualties occurred due to shooting and bombing incidents in Khan Younis and Deir al-Balah, while another individual died from previous injuries. Additionally, Israeli airstrikes targeted infrastructure, including a mosque and a water plant, in northern Gaza City.
