Kana malees, xiyyarri waraana Israa'el magaalaa Gaazaatti gamoo fi iddoo bishaan qulqulleessan dabalatee bu'uraalee misoomaa irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru.

title: Israeli spy Jonathan Pollard wants Iran ‘off the map’, says wars on Turkey and Egypt are next
english: Jonathan Pollard, a former US intelligence analyst who spied for Israel, has announced his candidacy for the Israeli Knesset while advocating for an aggressive expansion of regional military conflicts. He explicitly called for the destruction of Iran and labeled Egypt and Turkey as future strategic enemies that Israel must prepare to fight. Additionally, he proposed that Israel should unilaterally seize more territory in Lebanon and maintain full control over the future of Gaza.
amharic: ለእስራኤል ሰላይ በመሆን በአሜሪካ የታሰረው ዮናታን ፖላርድ፣ በእስራኤል ፓርላማ ለመወዳደር መዘጋጀቱን አስታውቋል። ፖላርድ እስራኤል ኢራንን ሙሉ በሙሉ ማጥፋት እንዳለባት እና ግብጽንና ቱርክንም እንደ ቀጣይ ጠላቶቿ በመቁጠር ለጦርነት መዘጋጀት እንዳለባት ተናግሯል። በተጨማሪም እስራኤል በሊባኖስ ግዛት ላይ ቁጥጥር ማድረግ እና የጋዛን እጣ ፈንታ በራሷ ብቻ መወሰን እንዳለባት አሳስቧል።
oromo: Jonaataan Polaard, isa duraan jaarmiyaa basaastuu Ameerikaa keessa hojjechaa turee fi Israa’eliif basaasummaa godhe, filannoo paarlaamaa Israa’el keessatti dorgomuuf murteeffateera. Polaard Israa’el biyya Iran lafarraa haxooftuu fi Itiyoophiyaa fi Turkiis akka diina itti aanutti ilaaluun waraanaaf akka qophooftu gaafateera. Kana malees, Israa’el daangaa Libaanoos bal’ifachuu fi haala Gaza irratti guutummaatti ofii ishii murteessuu qabdi jechuun yaada isaa ibseera.

title: Iran blacklists 45 tankers in Hormuz escalation
english: Iran has officially blacklisted 45 oil tankers, accusing them of violating regulations while navigating the Strait of Hormuz. Authorities have warned that they will penalize these vessels and any others that engage in trade with them. This move serves as a preemptive response to upcoming US sanctions aimed at isolating Iran's economy.
amharic: ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ላይ ደንቦችን ተላልፈዋል በሚል 45 የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከቦችን በጥቁር መዝገብ ውስጥ አስገብታለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን መርከቦች እና ከእነሱ ጋር የንግድ ግንኙነት የሚያደርጉ ሌሎች መርከቦችን እንደሚቀጡ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካ በኢራን ኢኮኖሚ ላይ ልትጥል ያቀደችውን አዲስ ማዕቀብ ለመመከት የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Iraan dooniiwwan boba'aa 45 ta'an seera galaana Hormuz cabsuu isaaniitiin ergaa 'black list' ykn tarree seeraan alaa keessatti galchiteetti. Mootummaan Iraan dooniiwwan kunneenis ta'e kanneen isaan waliin hojjetan irratti tarkaanfiin kan fudhatamu ta'uu akeekkachiiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame, Ameerikaan diinagdee Iraan miidhuuf adabbii haarawaa irratti fudhachuuf karoorfattee jirtuun wal qabatee dha.

title: US visa sanctions expose the limits of diplomatic pragmatism
english: The U.S. government has faced criticism for imposing visa restrictions on certain Tigrayan leaders, a move viewed by critics as prioritizing political convenience over addressing genocide. The article argues that true peace cannot be achieved without accountability and justice for the victims, rather than forcing cooperation with those accused of atrocities. By targeting these individuals, the policy is seen as undermining the pursuit of genuine reconciliation and human dignity in the post-conflict region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት በተወሰኑ የትግራይ አመራሮች ላይ የቪዛ እገዳ መጣሉ፣ የፍትህ እና የተጠያቂነት መርህን ከመከተል ይልቅ ፖለቲካዊ ጥቅምን ያስቀደመ ነው በሚል ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። በእርቅ ሂደት ውስጥ ለተፈጸሙ ግፍ እና የዘር ማጥፋት ወንጀሎች ተጠያቂነት ሳይኖር የሚደረግ ማንኛውም ድርድር ዘላቂ ሰላምን አያመጣም ሲል መጣጥፉ ይከራከራል። ይህ እርምጃ ሰላምን ለማምጣት ከማገዝ ይልቅ፣ የሰብአዊ መብት መከበርን ችላ በማለት ተጎጂዎችን ለተጨማሪ ጫና እንደሚዳርግ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganoota Tigraay tokko tokko irratti dhorkaa viizaa kaa'uun isaa, haqaa fi itti gaafatamummaa fuulduraatti fiduu mannaa faayidaa siyaasaa irratti xiyyeeffachuu akka ta'e qeeqameera. Barruun kun, yakka suukkanneessaa fi fixiinsa sanyii raawwatameef itti gaafatamummaan osoo hin jiraatin nagaan dhugaan dhufuu hin danda'u jedha. Tarkaanfiin kun nagaa buusuu mannaa, mirga namoomaa fi haqaa dagachuun miidhamtoota irratti dhiibbaa dabalataa uumuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: Samuel Eto’o urges support for embattled FIFA President Gianni Infantino
english: Samuel Eto’o, the head of Cameroon’s football association, has publicly defended FIFA President Gianni Infantino amidst growing calls for his resignation. Infantino is facing backlash from major football organizations over a failed private investment proposal for FIFA tournaments. Eto’o claims these attacks are politically motivated ahead of next year's election and believes Infantino has significantly improved opportunities for developing football nations.
amharic: የካሜሩን እግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ሳሙኤል ኤቶ ከስልጣን እንዲለቁ ግፊት እየተደረገበት ላለው የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ድጋፋቸውን ሰጥተዋል። ኢንፋንቲኖ ለፊፋ ውድድሮች የግል ኢንቨስትመንት ለማምጣት ባቀረቡት አወዛጋቢ እቅድ ምክንያት ከበርካታ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። ኤቶ ይህ ትችት በፊፋ መጪው ምርጫ ምክንያት የሚደረግ ፖለቲካዊ ሴራ ነው ሲሉ የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ኢንፋንቲኖ ለታዳጊ ሀገራት እድገት ትልቅ አስተዋጽኦ ማድረጋቸውን በመጥቀስ ድጋፋቸውን አሳይተዋል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin federeeshinii kubbaa miillaa Kaameruun Saamu'eel Eetoo, pirezedantii FIFA Jiyaanii Infaantiinoo kan dhiibbaan cimaan irra jiruuf deggarsa isaa ibseera. Infaantiinoon karoora investimentii dhuunfaa murnuu FIFA irratti qabuuf mormii cimaa dhaabbilee kubbaa miillaa gurguddoo irraa isa mudatee jira. Eetoo akka jedhetti, mormiin kun filannoo dhufu ilaalchisee kan ka'e fi siyaasa irratti kan xiyyeeffate dha; akkasumas Infaantiinoon biyyoota guddachaa jiraniif carraa kubbaa miillaa guddisuuf kan gargaare ta'uu eerera.

title: Why Israeli settler attacks on Palestinians in West Bank are pogroms
english: Escalating violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinians in the West Bank, often conducted with military support, is being increasingly described by experts and officials as pogroms. These attacks involve targeted raids on homes, villages, and farmland, with recent incidents drawing rare international condemnation. Furthermore, ongoing plans to expand settlements threaten to split the West Bank in two, severely restricting Palestinian movement and undermining hopes for a future state.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚኖሩ እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች በፍልስጤማውያን ላይ የሚያደርሱት ጥቃት እየተባባሰ መጥቷል፣ ይህም ድርጊት ብዙ ጊዜ በእስራኤል ወታደሮች ድጋፍ የሚፈጸም በመሆኑ ባለሙያዎች እንደ 'ፖግሮም' ወይም ስልታዊ የዘር ማጥቃት ይገልጹታል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች የፍልስጤማውያንን ቤት፣ ንብረት እና እርሻ ያነጣጠሩ ናቸው። በተጨማሪም፣ እስራኤል አዳዲስ ሰፈራዎችን ለማስፋፋት የምታደርገው እንቅስቃሴ የምዕራብ ባንክን ለሁለት በመክፈል የፍልስጤማውያንን የመንቀሳቀስ ነፃነት በእጅጉ ይገድባል ተብሎ ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Humni qubattoonni Israa'el naannoo Daangaa Lixaatti (West Bank) Falisxinoota irratti gaggeessan, kan yeroo baay'ee waraana Israa'eliin deeggaramu, yeroo ammaa ogeeyyotaan 'pogroom' ykn ajjeechaa sanyii irratti xiyyeeffate jedhamee ibsamaa jira. Humni kun manneen, qabeenyaa fi lafa qonnaa Falisxinootaa irratti qindoominaan kan raawwatamuudha. Kana malees, Israa'el babal'ina qubataaf karoora qabduun naannoo Daangaa Lixaa bakka lamatti hiruu fi bilisummaa sochiin Falisxinootaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatamaa jira.

title: Houses set on fire as fresh violence erupts in India’s Manipur
english: New ethnic violence has broken out in India's Manipur state, resulting in several homes being burned down. During the unrest, an exchange of gunfire between opposing groups left one security official wounded. This incident marks a continuation of long-standing tensions between the region's Hindu and Christian communities.
amharic: በህንድ ማኒፑር ግዛት በተቀሰቀሰ አዲስ የጎሳ ግጭት በርካታ መኖሪያ ቤቶች በእሳት ተቃጥለዋል። በግጭቱ ወቅት በተኩስ ልውውጥ አንድ የጸጥታ አባል ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ በሚኖሩ የሂንዱ እና የክርስትና እምነት ተከታዮች መካከል ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲካሄድ በቆየው ግጭት ቀጣይ ክፍል ሆኖ ተመዝግቧል።

title: Houthis say they attacked vessel off Saudi Arabia
english: The Houthi movement in Yemen claimed responsibility for attacking a ship near the Saudi Arabian port of Yanbu. A tanker was reportedly hit by a projectile, but all crew members are safe and no environmental damage occurred. Saudi officials have not yet addressed the incident, which occurred at a vital oil export hub.

oromo: Humni Huthotaa kan Yaman, markaba tokko kan magaalota Yambu, kan Saudi Arabiyaa keessatti argamtu irraa dhiyoo jiru irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa beeksisan. Markabni boba'aa kun meeshaa waraanaatiin rukutamee jiraatus, namoonni markabicha keessa turan hundi fayyaa qabu akkasumas miidhaan naannoo irra ga'e hin jiru. title: Egyptian-UAE free zone for oil storage and trading established in New Alamein
english: Egypt and the UAE have launched the Fujairah Alamein Oil and Gas Company, establishing a private free zone in New Alamein for the storage and trade of petroleum products. This major project covers over 700,000 square meters and requires the firm to export all its output to global markets. The initiative is part of Egypt's strategy to become a regional hub for energy logistics through strengthened cooperation with international partners.
amharic: ግብፅ እና የተባበሩት አረብ ኤምሬቶች የነዳጅ ምርቶችን ለማከማቸት እና ለመገበያየት የሚያስችል የፉጃይራ አልአሜይን የነዳጅ እና ጋዝ ኩባንያን በኒው አልአሜይን ከተማ መስርተዋል። ይህ ከ700,000 ካሬ ሜትር በላይ ቦታን የሚሸፍን ፕሮጀክት ኩባንያው የሚያመርተውን ምርት በሙሉ ለውጭ ገበያ እንዲልክ ይጠይቃል። ይህ ስምምነት ግብፅ ከዓለም አቀፍ አጋሮቿ ጋር በመተባበር የኃይል ማዕከል ለመሆን የምታደርገው ጥረት አካል ነው።
oromo: Misir fi Emiratonni Arabaa tokko ta'uun dhaabbata boba'aa fi gaazii 'Fujairah Alamein' jedhamu magaalaa New Alamein keessatti hundeesseera. Bakkeen kun kuusaa fi daldala boba'aa kan oolu yoo ta'u, lafa bal'ina isaa meetira iskuweerii 700,000 olii irratti kan ijaarame dha. Dhaabbatichi oomisha isaa guutuu gara gabaa addunyaatti akka ergu kan dirqamu yoo ta'u, kunis carraaqqii Misir damee anniisaa irratti giddu-gala naannichaa ta'uuf gootu keessaa tokko dha.

title: Israel bars two Swedish MEPs from entering occupied West Bank
english: Israeli authorities denied entry to two Swedish European Parliament members at Ben Gurion Airport, preventing their planned visit to the West Bank. The Israeli foreign ministry justified the ban by claiming the lawmakers have consistently opposed Israel and promoted false allegations regarding humanitarian conduct. The two Swedish officials had intended to meet with humanitarian groups to observe the situation in refugee camps, a move they state was unrelated to the Palestinian Authority.

title: Rain and flooding from Typhoon Narra hits China and Vietnam
english: Typhoon Narra has brought severe weather, including intense rainfall and flooding, to northern Vietnam and southern China. The storm has caused significant property damage, forcing thousands of people to flee their homes. Sadly, authorities have confirmed at least one fatality in northern Vietnam due to the disaster.

title: Access to Zambian courts prevented as election petition deadline looms
english: Zambian authorities have closed several court buildings across the country, including the Supreme and Constitutional Courts, right as the deadline to challenge the recent presidential election results approaches. Opposition candidate Brian Mundubile, who claims the election was flawed, is now effectively blocked from filing his legal challenge against President Hakainde Hichilema’s victory. While the government cites security concerns for the shutdowns, critics argue this move is an attempt to stop the legal opposition and secure the president's upcoming inauguration.

oromo: Mootummaan Zambiyaa yeroo murtaa'een bu'aa filannoo pirezidaantummaa mormuuf kenname ga'aa utuu jiruu, manneen murtii gurguddoo biyyattii cufuu isaa gabaasameera. Tarkaanfiin kun kandindeetiin mormituu Biraayin Mundubiile bu'aa filannichaa seeraan mormuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru akka hin raawwanne gufuu ta'eera. Mootummaan sababa nageenyaatiin cufuu isaa ibsuus, qaamooleen mormituu garuu tarkaanfiin kun aangoo Pirezidaant Haakaayindee Hiichiilemaa kabachiisuuf yaadamee kan fudhatameedha jedhu.

title: ‘Barrel bomb mufti’ sentenced to life in Syria
english: Ahmad Hassoun, a prominent religious leader who served under Bashar al-Assad's previous Syrian government, has been handed a life sentence. Often called the 'barrel bomb mufti,' he was convicted for his role in war crimes committed throughout the nation's long-running civil conflict. This sentencing marks a significant development in the pursuit of accountability for atrocities linked to the former regime.

oromo: Ahmad Hassoun, gaggeessaan amantii olaanaa kan mootummaa Bashar al-Assad durii keessatti tajaajilaa turan, hidhaa umrii guutuu itti murameera. 'Muftii boombii barmeelii' jedhamanii kan beekaman kun, waraana biyyattii keessatti waggaa 14f gaggeeffame keessatti yakka waraanaa raawwachuun isaanii mirkanaa'eera. Murteen kun mootummaa kanaan duraa irratti yakka raawwatameef itti gaafatamummaa mirkaneessuuf tarkaanfii guddaa dha.

title: Saudi Arabia’s MBS visits Macron in France: What to expect
english: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is visiting France for meetings with President Emmanuel Macron to strengthen bilateral ties. The two leaders plan to sign various agreements covering sectors like energy, transportation, and healthcare, including a potential deal for a major Japanese-inspired theme park. They are also discussing regional security concerns and strategies to secure energy supplies amid ongoing conflicts affecting global trade routes.

title: Four arrested over fatal shooting of South African boxer Zolani Tete
english: South African authorities have arrested four individuals in connection with the fatal shooting of two-time world champion boxer Zolani Tete outside his home in the Eastern Cape. One suspect faces formal murder charges following the attack, which also left a female passenger injured. Tete, a celebrated athlete known for recording the fastest knockout in a world title fight, was killed while preparing for a planned return to professional boxing.

title: South Korea says US cancelled upcoming joint marine exercises over Iran war
english: The United States has cancelled an upcoming major amphibious military exercise with South Korea, citing the need to prioritize forces for the ongoing US-Israel conflict with Iran. This decision follows President Trump’s recent move to reduce other joint military drills due to costs and disagreements regarding Seoul's involvement in the Middle East. Despite these changes, tensions remain high as North Korea continues to conduct missile tests and express hostility toward any remaining US-South Korean training activities.

title: Chinese President Xi calls for diplomatic solution to Middle East crisis
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping met with Jordan's King Abdullah II to advocate for a peaceful, diplomatic resolution to the ongoing Middle East conflict. Xi emphasized the importance of a two-state solution for the Israeli-Palestinian issue while respecting the sovereignty of regional nations. During the visit, the two leaders also strengthened their bilateral cooperation by signing several new agreements regarding trade and diplomatic relations.

oromo: Pirezidaantiin Chaayinaa Sii Jiinpiing mootii Yordaanoos Mootii Abdallaah II waliin mari'achuudhaan walitti bu'iinsa Baha Giddu-galeessaa karaa nagaa fi dippilomaasii akka hiikamu gaafataniiru. Pirezidaantichi dhimmi Israa'elii fi Falasxiin furmaata biyyoota lamaa irratti hundaa'ee akka hiikamu fi mirgi abbaa biyyummaa biyyoota naannichaa akka kabajamu hubachiisaniiru. Marii kana keessatti, biyyoonni lameen walitti dhufeenya daldalaa fi dippilomaasii isaanii cimsuuf waliigaltee mallatteessaniiru.

title: The Palestinian-American determined to defend his home from Israeli settlers
english: Louai Abu Ridi, a Palestinian-American living in Ohio, traveled back to his hometown of Qusra in the occupied West Bank to protect his home from Israeli settlers. After watching via security cameras as armed settlers besieged his property and built tents outside, he decided he could no longer stay away. He is now determined to defend his ancestral home and support his family, despite receiving little help from US officials.
amharic: በኦሃዮ የሚኖረው ፍልስጤማዊው አሜሪካዊ ሉአይ አቡ ሪዲ፣ በምዕራብ ባንክ የሚገኘውን ቤቱን ከእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ለመጠበቅ ወደ ትውልድ ከተማው ወደ ኩስራ ተመልሷል። የደህንነት ካሜራዎችን በመጠቀም የታጠቁ ሰፋሪዎች ቤቱን ከበው ድንኳን እንደተከሉ ከተመለከተ በኋላ፣ ከአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት በቂ ድጋፍ ባለማግኘቱ እራሱ በአካል ተገኝቶ ቤቱን ለመከላከል ወስኗል። አሁን በቤቱ ውስጥ በመገኘት የቤተሰቡን ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ እና ሰፋሪዎቹ ቤቱን እንዳይረከቡት ቁርጠኛ ሆኖ እየሰራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Lubai Abuu Ridii kan jedhamu lammiin Ameerikaa fi Falasxiin kan Ohaayoo jiraatu, mana isaa kan Qusra, Lixaa Baankii jiru qe’ee isaa irraa buqqisuuf kanneen yaalan irraa ittisuuf gara biyyaatti deebi’e. Inni mana isaa keessa seetanii buufata godhatanii fi qabeenya isaa marfatan erga kaameraa nageenyaatiin argee booda, mootummaan Ameerikaa gargaarsa waan hin gooneef ofii isaa achi deemee ittisuuf murteesse. Amma mana isaa keessa taa’ee, maatii isaa waliin ta’uun qe’ee isaa kanneen weeraran irraa qolachuuf gadi ba’ee hojjechaa jira.

title: Trump says Iran 'collapsing' ahead of sanctions announcement
english: President Donald Trump recently declared that Iran is experiencing a total collapse. This statement came shortly before the United States administration planned to reveal new, severe economic sanctions against the country. The president shared this message on his social media account to highlight the impact of US pressure on Tehran.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ኢራን በአሁኑ ወቅት ሙሉ በሙሉ እየፈራረሰች እንደሆነ ተናግረዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ አዲስ እና ከባድ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል ከመገለጹ ጥቂት ሰዓታት ቀደም ብሎ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንቱ ይህንን መልእክት በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ገጻቸው ላይ በማስፈር በቴህራን ላይ እየተደረገ ያለውን ተፅዕኖ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Donaald Traamp, biyyi Iraan amma ammaan tana guutummaatti kufaatii keessa jirti jechuun ibsan. Ibsi kun kan kenname, mootummaan Ameerikaa adabbii cimaa ta'e kan biyyattii irratti lafa kaayuuf qophaa'aa jiru sa'aatii muraasa dura ture. Pirezedaantichi ergaa kana miidiyaa hawaasummaa isaanii irratti maxxansuun, dhiibbaan Ameerikaa Teehraan irratti qabu maal akka fakkaatu ibsaniiru.

title: Activists occupy UK aircraft parts factory over Israel links
english: Pro-Palestine activists from a group called 'People Against Genocide' have occupied a British factory belonging to Martin-Baker. The protesters are targeting the facility because they claim it manufactures ejection-seat parts for Israeli military aircraft. Their stated goal is to interrupt the United Kingdom's ongoing military support for Israel during the current conflict.
amharic: የ'People Against Genocide' ቡድን አባላት የሆኑ የፍልስጤም ደጋፊ አክቲቪስቶች በእንግሊዝ የሚገኝ የማርቲን-ቤከር ፋብሪካን ተቆጣጠሩ። ተቃዋሚዎቹ ድርጅቱ ለእስራኤል ወታደራዊ አውሮፕላኖች የሚሆኑ የመቀመጫ ክፍሎችን እንደሚያቀርብ በመግለጽ ፋብሪካውን ኢላማ አድርገዋል። የዚህ እንቅስቃሴ ዋና ዓላማ የእንግሊዝ መንግሥት ለእስራኤል እያደረገ ያለውን ወታደራዊ ድጋፍ ለማስተጓጎል ነው።
oromo: Duula degartoota Falastimii kan ta'an gareen 'People Against Genocide' jedhamu, warshaa Maartin-Beekar kan biyya Ingiliiz keessa jiru tokko dhaadannoowwan dhageessisuun qabatanii jiru. Duulatti kun warshaan kun xiyyaarota waraana Israa'el fayyadamuuf kan gargaaran, keessumaa teessoo xiyyaarotaa kan oomishu ta'uu himuun mormii qaban ibsatan. Kaayyoon isaanii kanneenis gargaarsa waraana Ingiliiz Israa'elif taasisaa jirtu gufachiisuu akka ta'e beekameera.

title: Former NBA player Enes Kanter ejected after confrontation with WNBA’s Cloud
english: Former NBA player Enes Kanter Freedom was removed from a WNBA game between the Chicago Sky and Indiana Fever following a heated verbal exchange with player Natasha Cloud. Kanter, who was sitting courtside wearing a shirt expressing his views on gender, approached the court after Cloud confronted him during a timeout. Security intervened to separate the two, leading to Kanter's ejection from the arena, while Cloud later emphasized her support for the trans community on social media.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኤንቢኤ ተጫዋች ኤነስ ካንተር ፍሪደም በቺካጎ ስካይ እና በኢንዲያና ፋቨር መካከል በተደረገው የደብሊውኤንቢኤ ጨዋታ ወቅት ከተጫዋች ናታሻ ክላውድ ጋር በተፈጠረ አለመግባባት ከስፍራው ተባረረ። ካንተር በጨዋታው ወቅት ስለ ጾታ ያለውን አመለካከት የሚያሳይ ቲሸርት ለብሶ በሜዳው አቅራቢያ ተቀምጦ የነበረ ሲሆን፣ ክላውድ በጨዋታው እረፍት ጊዜ እርሱን በመቃወሟ ወደ ሜዳው በመቅረቡ ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎች ጣልቃ በመግባት ካንተርን ከሜዳው ያወጡት ሲሆን፣ ክላውድ በኋላ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ለትራንስጀንደር ማህበረሰብ ያላትን ድጋፍ ገልጻለች።
oromo: Taphataan NBA duraanii Enes Kanter Freedom, tapha WNBA kan Chicago Sky fi Indiana Fever gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture irratti taphattuu Natasha Cloud waliin wal-dhabdee uumameen dirree irraa arii'ameera. Kanter, uffata waa'ee saalaa ilaalchisee yaada isaa ibsu uffatee gubbaa dirree taa'aa osoo jiruu, erga Cloud isa qeequu jalqabdee booda gara dirree itti dhihaate. Eegdonni nageenyaa gidduu seenuun Kanterin ganda taphichaa keessaa baasanii jiru; erga taatee kanaa booda Cloud miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti hawaasa tiransijendaraaf deggarsa qabdu ibsiteetti.

title: Israel accused of using kites as pretext to justify escalating Gaza attacks
english: Israel has launched deadly airstrikes across Gaza, claiming they are a response to children flying kites and balloons from the area. While Israeli officials justify these attacks as a security necessity, critics argue that the government is using these harmless toys as a fake pretext to intensify violence and undermine potential ceasefire talks. Recent strikes have resulted in several casualties, including a young child, despite reports confirming that the kites posed no real threat.
amharic: እስራኤል በጋዛ ህጻናት በሚያበሯቸው ወረቀት መጫወቻዎች እና ፊኛዎች ምክንያት ነው በሚል ከፍተኛ የአየር ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱን ለደህንነት ሲባል አስፈላጊ ነው ቢሉም፣ ተቺዎች ግን መንግስት ይህንን ሰበብ በመጠቀም ጥቃቱን ለማጠናከር እና የተኩስ አቁም ድርድርን ለማደናቀፍ እየሞከረ ነው ሲሉ ይከሳሉ። ጥቃቱ ምንም አይነት ፈንጂ በሌላቸው መጫወቻዎች ምክንያት የተፈጸመ ቢሆንም፣ የበርካታ ሰዎች ህይወት መጥፋቱን ተከትሎ ከፍተኛ ቁጣ ቀስቅሷል።
oromo: Israa'el daa'imman Gaazaatti xuurommii (kites) fi fuyyee akka taphataatti fayyadamaa turan sababa godhachuun haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatteetti. Mootummaan Israa'el haleellaa kana nageenyaaf barbaachisaa dha jedhee kan falmu ta'us, qorattoonni garuu mootummaan kun gocha kana akka sababaatti fayyadamuun haleellaa isaa jabeessuufi marii dhaabbii waraanaa gufachiisuu akka barbaadu ibsu. Haleellaa kanaan yeroo xuurommiin sun dhoontuu hin qabaachuu isaanii mirkanaa'e jiruus, ijoollee dabalatee lubbuun namoota baay'ee darbeera.

title: Cambuur fans suffer burns as fireworks set off during Dutch league match
english: During a Dutch league football match, Feyenoord supporters threw fireworks at Cambuur fans, causing burns, eye injuries, and hearing damage to several attendees. The game was briefly suspended, but officials allowed it to continue despite the violence. Both the local authorities and the Dutch football association are now investigating the incident and reviewing safety protocols for future matches.
amharic: በኔዘርላንድስ የሊግ እግር ኳስ ጨዋታ ወቅት የፌይኖርድ ደጋፊዎች በተቃራኒ ቡድን ደጋፊዎች ላይ ርችቶችን በመወርወራቸው በርካታ የካምቡር ደጋፊዎች ላይ የቃጠሎ፣ የዓይን እና የመስማት ችግር ደርሷል። ጨዋታው ለተወሰነ ጊዜ ቢቋረጥም፣ ግጭቱ ቢኖርም ዳኞች ጨዋታው እንዲቀጥል ፈቅደዋል። የኔዘርላንድስ እግር ኳስ ማህበር እና የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እየጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ የወደፊት የደህንነት ደንቦችንም ለመገምገም ወስነዋል።
oromo: Tapha kubbaa miilaa biyya Neezarlaandi irratti, deggertoonni garee Feyenoord deggertoota garee Cambuur irratti firaaywarkiin roobsisuun namoota hedduu irratti gubaa, miidhaa ijaa fi gurraa geessisaniiru. Taphi kun yeroo gabaabaaf addaan citus, miidhaan gahuu isaa irra iyyuu abbootiin taayitaa taphichi akka itti fufu hayyamaniiru. Waldaan kubbaa miilaa Neezarlaandi fi bulchiistonni naannichaa dhimmicha qorachaa jiru akkasumas seera eegumsa fayyaa fi tasgabbii gara fuulduraa irratti jijjiirama gochuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: Colombia lifts coal export ban on Israel imposed over Gaza genocide
english: Colombia's new right-wing administration has officially overturned the previous government's coal export ban on Israel. President Abelardo de la Espriella, who took office recently, is reversing former leader Gustavo Petro's policies as part of a broader move to strengthen diplomatic and economic ties with Israel. This decision restores a vital energy supply for Israel, marking a significant shift in Colombia's international stance on the conflict in Gaza.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያ አዲስ የቀኝ ዘመም መንግስት ከዚህ ቀደም በኢስራኤል ላይ ተጥሎ የነበረውን የድንጋይ ከሰል ንግድ ክልከላ አነሳ። አዲሱ ፕሬዚዳንት አቤላርዶ ደ ላ እስፕሪኤላ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ጉስታቮ ፔትሮ የነበሩትን ፖሊሲዎች በመቀየር ከኢስራኤል ጋር ያላቸውን ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ግንኙነት እያጠናከሩ ይገኛሉ። ይህ ውሳኔ ለኢስራኤል የኃይል አቅርቦትን እንደገና የሚፈቅድ ሲሆን በጋዛ ጦርነት ላይ የኮሎምቢያን የውጭ ግንኙነት አቋም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀይሮታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Kolombiyaa haaraan mirgaa, dhorkaa ergaa cimaa (coal) Israa'eel irratti duraan turerraa kaaseera. Pireezidaantiin haaraan Abelardo de la Espriella, siyaasa pireezidaantii duraanii Gustaavo Peetroo jijjiiruun hariiroo dippilomaasii fi diinagdee Israa'eel wajjin qaban cimsuuf tarkaanfii fudhataniiru. Murteen kun Israa'eelif gargaarsa anniisaa deebisee kan kennu yoo ta'u, gama siyaasaa alaa Kolombiyaan waraana Gaazaa ilaalchisee qabdu jijjiiruu isaati.

title: Photos: Towering landfill collapse kills 30 in Guinea’s capital, Conakry
english: At least 30 people died and six were injured after a massive pile of trash collapsed at a landfill in Conakry, Guinea, following heavy rain. The landslide destroyed several homes in a nearby residential area where families were still living despite receiving eviction notices. Authorities are now focusing on rescue efforts and the relocation of survivors from the disaster site.

title: Sanctions didn't break Iran. They hardened it
english: Despite severe international sanctions, a naval blockade, and significant economic challenges like soaring inflation, Iran's economy has avoided total collapse. The nation's limited integration with global financial markets and lack of foreign debt have acted as a buffer, preventing typical capital flight and financial panic. Instead of breaking under the pressure, the Iranian system has adapted, with domestic markets even hitting record highs during the conflict.
